articleTitle: Use of Approaches to the Methodology of Factor Analysis of Information Risks for the Quantitative Assessment of Information Risks Based on the Formation of Cause-And-Effect Links
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper suggests methods to the assessment of information risks, which makes the transition from a qualitative assessment of information risks (according to the factor analysis of information risks methodology) to a quantitative assessment. The development factor analysis of information risks methodology of the methodology was carried out using the mathematical apparatus of probability theory, namely Bayesian networks. A comparative analysis of the standard factor analysis of information risks methodology and the developed methodology using statistical data was carried out. During the analysis, the cause and effect relationships of the confidentiality violation have been formed, defined and given in the corresponding table and in the form of the Ishikawa diagram. As an example, it was calculated the amount of risk the company may be exposed to in case of violation of information confidentiality according to the standard factor analysis of information risks methodology and the developed methodology. It is shown that the use of proposed technique allows quantifying the risk assessment that can be obtained using the factor analysis of information risks methodology.

articleTitle: Optimization of Data Transfer in Cooperative Surveillance Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the paper, based on the consideration of the problem of detecting signals in cooperative observation systems as a test of two hypotheses, the optimal rule for detecting signals in the case of an arbitrary cost function is obtained and it is shown that the best value for the Bayesian value should be compared with the threshold of the generalized likelihood ratio, and the threshold value does not depend on the algorithm and the quality of the interrogator, but is completely determined by the decision costs for the system as a whole. The method of the response signals processing of cooperative observation systems with preliminary inter-period processing proposed in the work allowed to improving the quality of air objects detection and reducing the effect of the aircraft's responder readiness factor on the quality of the air facility detection, which leads to a corresponding improvement in the quality of information support for decision-makers.

articleTitle: Analysis of Single-Board Computers for IoT and IIoT Solutions in Embedded Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article presents analysis of single-board computers for Internet of Things solutions. Analysis of single-board computers for Industrial Internet of Things solutions. Overview of the use of single-board computers in embedded control systems. Analyzed the possibility of application distribution by using ESP8266 and CC2530. As a result of the analysis, criteria were established by which it is possible to choose a single-board computer for Internet of Things or Industrial Internet of Things solutions. Single board computer model selection propose based on vector synthesis. The paper also discusses the design and use of these criteria when choosing single-board computers.

articleTitle: Development of Infocommunication System for Scientific Activity Administration of Educational Environment’s Subjects
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Publication considers main aspects of infocommunication system development for scientific activity administration of educational environment's subjects on the basis of scientific activity results in project-vector space presentation. The method of administrative influence vector constructing is proposed, which allows to increase the efficiency of scientific research projects results achievement by more accurate and timely application of administrative influence means. Developed information technology makes it possible to simplify the management of educational environment's subjects by identifying the aspects of activity that need to be influenced. The integration of technology with micro-service evaluation of scientific research results "The base of scientists of Ukraine" is presented.

articleTitle: Noise Immunity of Data Transfer Channels in Cooperative Observation Systems: Comparative Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper compares the noise immunity of the existing data channel in of cooperative surveillance systems, which is based on the use of a positional code, with a proposed data transfer method, which applies the time interval coding of transmitted data and is implemented on the basis of non-synchronous and asynchronous networks of observation systems. It is shown that the proposed method of data transfer makes it possible to reduce the response signal flow intensity in cooperative surveillance systems enabling a decrease in the level of intra-system interference in the response channel and, as a consequence, an improvement improve the noise immunity of the data channel in cooperative surveillance systems. This excludes the unauthorized use of aircraft transponders by any interested party either for obtaining information or for violating its integrity and eliminates the problem of the carrying capacity of aircraft transponders in the considered surveillance systems, and also excludes the unauthorized use of aircraft transponders by any interested party either for obtaining information or for violating its integrity.

articleTitle: Methods for Synthesis of Relational Data Model in Information Systems Reengineering Problems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The purpose of the article is to develop a method for reengineering relational databases, taking into account the presence of implicit interrelated functionally dependent data that affect the structure of the logical model. The following results are obtained: the article proposes an approach to detecting previously unknown functional dependences, based on the analysis of a set of relational database. Classes of relational databases reengineering problems are singled out; the stage of forming the target logical scheme, common to the problems of adaptation and refactoring, is investigated. The sub-task of verification of the relational database logical scheme correspondence to the third normal form within the framework of this stage is considered using the synthesis method; it is shown that its solution involves a number of difficulties, in particular, the need to find the set of functional dependences being performed using the current data instance of some relational database. An approach is proposed for finding a set of functional dependencies from the relational structure data instance. As a direction for further research, one can highlight the implementation of empty values support at the stage of detection of functional dependences, as well as issues of data transfer without loss from the original structure of the database to the target one, obtained as a result of applying the reengineering methods.

articleTitle: Development of the iBeacon’s Positioning Algorithm for Indoor Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In future mobile communication systems the most of data usage is expected within indoor environment such as big entertainment and shopping centers, subway, etc. Therefore, the positioning in the big building becomes more and more popular. Existing GPS and other positioning systems can't provide a target accuracy for the indoor due to high complexity, low reliability and high price for deployment. Therefore, new development in this area is needed to leverage other technologies for positioning information, such as WiFi, Bluetooth, mobile technologies, etc. In this paper, we introduce the new approach for indoor positioning system based on iBeacon technology. We have analyzed the accuracy of iBeacon systems for indoor scenarios taking into account the signal attenuation on the most common obstacles. The performance of the proposed system has been analyzed by the real experimental measurements in the indoor environment. Finally, we have developed the new machine learning based algorithm to improve the accuracy of the proposed system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control System of Biotechnological Objects with Fuzzy Controller and Noise Filtration Unit
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article presents the study results of the intelligent control systems for biotechnological objects using the example of a greenhouse. A measuring system for effectively study of solar radiation and prediction of possible violations of information was developed. Neural networks were used as a mathematical tool for predicting temperature time series. The information channels of solar radiation were filtered using the Hilbert-Huang transformation. A transformational mathematical filter was developed, which made it possible to significantly increase the accuracy of solar radiation intensity prediction. The optimal weights for the neural network of predicting the time series of solar radiation intensity were determined with the application of the genetic algorithm. The developed vegetable production control system allows ensuring the maximum profit from the products sale and minimizes energy costs by introducing an additional unit of the neural network prediction of external disturbances and to determine control actions using fuzzy controllers.

articleTitle: Search by Image. New Search Engine Service Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Every year millions of photos and images appear in the Internet. Most of them are downloaded to personal cloud storage or become available to the public. With such a huge amount of information, the need for an effective search in the picture ripens. And if excellent tools have already been created for text search, image search remains an unresolved problem. The purpose of this publication is to develop a model for creating an effective image search service.

articleTitle: Formation of a Consolidated Information Resource by Means of Cloud Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The authors analyze the possibilities of preserving the consolidated information resources of libraries, archives, museums and electronic collections of mass media, as institutes of social memory, by means of cloud technologies. The main aspects of forming the platforms of the consolidated information resource of the institutes of social memory and media using cloud services are analyzed. The authors emphasize that an integrated methodology for the formation of consolidated information resources, based on the funds of the above mentioned institutes of social memory in Ukraine, has not been created. The authors proposed a socio-communicative system of the consolidated information resource of institutes of social memory. The main elements of the system of the consolidated information resource of social memory are presented. During the research, a comparative analysis was conducted and a software product for storing a consolidated information resource was identified. On the example of the city Zboriv, the authors considered the possibility of preserving the consolidated information resources of the city library, archive, museum.

articleTitle: Information and Measurement System Based on Wireless Sensory Infocommunication Network for Polygon Testing of Guided and Unguided Rockets and Missiles
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The work is focused on developing automation methods of the optical information-measuring system for the detection and support of guided and unguided rockets, artillery and reactive ammunitions at their field tests on the range. The basic idea is to use small-scale optoelectronic station of trajectory measurements with high-speed noninertial drives that are located along the route of an ammunition flight. All optoelectronic station of trajectory measurements are merged into a single information-measuring system. Each optoelectronic station of trajectory measurements in its area of responsibility is programmed to support the target in the predicted trajectory. The programming process is automated and carried out simultaneously for all optoelectronic station of trajectory measurements. For the synchronization and correction of the issuance of the target for each optoelectronic station of trajectory measurements in the process of escorting an ammunition, it is proposed to use the technologies of the wireless sensor info communication network.

Author Keywords: detection technology and high precision object tracking

articleTitle: Management for the Operators Activity in the Polyergatic System. Method of Functions Distribution on the Basis of the Reliability Model of System States
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article shows the relevance of the tasks of the human factor in polyergatic system. The authors suggest a mathematical formulation of the optimization problem in the distribution of functions between the operators subject to resource constraints, technological and ergonomic requirements. The article demonstrates the capabilities of the computer implementation models.

articleTitle: Monitoring Subsystem for Wireless Systems Based on Miniature Spectrum Analyzers
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper presents a substantiation of the effectiveness of the implementation of IEEE 802.11 wireless network analysis subsystem using miniature spectrum analyzers. A practical implementation scheme, approaches to the software solution and hardware are shown. Design and implementation is presented.

articleTitle: Development of Solar Panels Detector
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper describes the method of detection of roof-installed solar photovoltaic panels in low-quality satellite photos. It is important to receive the geospatial data (such as country, zip code, street and home number) of installed solar panels, because they are connected directly to the local power. It will be helpful to estimate a power capacity and an energy production using the satellite photos. For this purpose, a Convolutional Neural Network was used. For training and testing dataset consists of low-quality Google satellite images was used. The experimental results show a high rate accuracy of detection with low rate incorrect classifications of the proposed approach. The proposed approach has enormous implementation and can be improved in future.

articleTitle: Multilink Approach for the Content Delivery in 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: 5G-Xcast is a project focused on Broadcast and Multicast Communication Enablers For the Fifth Generation of Wireless Systems. Within the project for the most defined use cases, it is necessary to provide needed throughput, delay and reliability. For this purpose, the multi-connectivity approach can be used. 5G multi-connectivity is one of the key enablers in order to satisfy the demanding requirements of 5G mobile networks. Multilink is one kind of multi-connectivity within the 5G-Xcast project. This paper describes multilink benefits, its high-level description and implementation to the 5G core architecture for better user experience and reducing costs of mobile network operators.

articleTitle: Experimental Studies Of The Modern Symmetric Stream Ciphers
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper is a continuation of numerous studies of a candidate for encryption national standard of Ukraine, the Strumok new symmetric stream cipher. The result of a study is compare the most famous algorithms of stream cipher, which were presented at various contests, such as eSTREAM, NESSIE and the AES symmetric block cipher in mode of stream about usage CPU time for transformation of one octet data.

articleTitle: A Swarm Method for Segmentation of Images Obtained from On-Board Optoelectronic Surveillance Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: It was analyzed the main atmospheric factors effecting formation of optoelectronic images. It was done the analysis of the known methods of images segmentation received from the board of the optoelectronic surveillance systems. It has been established the basic disadvantages inherent of the classical images segmentation methods. It was suggested a swarm segmentation method of images obtained from on-board optoelectronic surveillance systems. As a method of segmentation, it was suggested to use the method of artificial bee colony. Experimental results on segmentation of the optoelectronic image were conducted by artificial bee colony method.

articleTitle: Method of Error Control of the Information Presented in the Modular Number System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A method for error control in the modular number system (MNS) based on the use of the zeroing procedure is proposed. This method is designed to verify the correct implementation of the computing process of computer systems and components. It is assumed that the error in one module remainder does not affect the residual values corresponding to other modules (bases) of the MNS. The essence of the proposed method is that, when performing the procedure of zeroing in the MNS, the operation of determining is combined in time, in accordance with the corresponding digits of the number A, the zeroing constant and the calculation operation for the corresponding values of the digits of the number A. This makes it possible to increase the efficiency of monitoring information presented in the modular number system.

articleTitle: Phytomonitoring in a Greenhouse Based on Arduino Hardware
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Realized the software and hardware of phytomonitoring subsystem in the greenhouse on the basis of the LabVIEW software environment and Arduino's hardware support and carried out checking this subsystem in manufacturing. It is shown that at cultivating vegetables next to thetmal characteristics of the environment, the information about plants' temperature is important. It is analyzed dependences of temperature of plants on illumination in greenhouse, obtained the refined mathematical model of the greenhouse suitable for the formation of control influences taking into account spatial distribution control object.

articleTitle: Analysis of Packet Jitter in Multiservice Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Jitter of packet delay is a very important value that determines the quality of service of multiservice networks. In this paper, we consider the G/M/1 queue system and the problem of estimating jitter in this system. A technique for estimating jitter in a simulation model was proposed where streams with exponential packet length distribution and exponential, Pareto and Weibull distributions of time intervals between packets, used as examples of random distribution, were processed. Comparison of results of simulation modeling and analytical estimation of jitter is given.

Author Keywords: distribution of time intervals between packets

articleTitle: Proposals for Improving of Air Surveillance Informativity in MIMO Radar Systems Based on Two-Dimensional Radars
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper considers the proposals for improving of air surveillance informativity in small-base MIMO radar system based on two-dimensional radars. It is proposed the method of calculating the third coordinate (altitude) by means of increasing the informativity of the MIMO Radars system. This becomes possible as a result of the use of information contained in the structure of the electromagnetic field more efficient than in the monostatic two-coordinate radar. The calculations of the altitude measurement error of the multistatic radar system are carried out by the mathematical model method.

articleTitle: Authentication Method in Contactless Payment Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article proposes a modification of the customer's identification method in terms of biometric identification and geolocation of users. The stages of identification are considered, accounting for set of characteristics (tuple of geolocation data, i.e. user motion through time and space, and parameters of their purchase). Based on the above mentioned data, the table of payment statistical probability is created; the user is identified on the basis of the table. Data tuple of client's movements and making a purchase is clustered by comparing the distance from the user location coordinates and time of their payment to the boundaries of existing clusters, allocating user to either the “identified”, “unidentified”, or “requires the identification of the PIN (Personal identification number)”. The necessary conditions for implementing a contactless payment system are high level of security, easy to use, which has the ability to work without a bank card, reliability, flexibility, scalability, efficiency. The proposed method makes it possible to increase the level of transaction security, reduce theft contributes to increasing of the attractiveness of implementation of this technology in banks.

articleTitle: Method of Data Collection in Wireless Sensor Networks Using Flying Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks are characterized by the presence of border nodes, which do not always allow data to be transmitted at the required rate. Constant change in routing of data flows forces sensors to work more frequently in the router mode. This increases energy costs, creates an excessive electromagnetic field. In highly specialized hidden sensor networks, a problem arises where frequent radio emission of the sensor is generally undesirable. A new method of data collection in wireless sensor networks is proposed. It is built on the use of an overlay mobile wireless self-organizing network. It is proposed to implement unmanned aerial vehicles as nodes of such a network. The organization of network operation provides for the use of Flying Ad Hoc Network technology. The proposed method includes: partition of the terrain map with sensors into cells, step-by-step data collection, absence of collisions (simultaneous or repeated data collection in one cell). In this method, it is assumed that drones should either exchange service information about the route of movement and the cells they visited, or initially know the route. The results of the model experiment are presented in the paper. The results show the effectiveness of the method. A promising direction of development is the modification of this method for operation in the conditions of electromagnetic suppression, both with known and unknown coordinates of the sensors.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Quasi-Fractal Hemispherical Dielectric Resonator Antennas
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper considers the models quasi-fractal dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) based on a hemispherical. Thus, the influence of the depth of the overlap of the constituent elements in the spatial-frequency characteristics DRA. The interaction of the antennas of non-Euclidean geometry with radio waves is described difficult. It is therefore advisable to perform the synthesis of these antennas by mathematical modelling using the Ansoft HFSS package. To simplify the analysis of the characteristics of the antennas, their arrangement is limited geometrical structure, which has five elements on one horizontal surface. Evaluation and comparison of antennas held by the following characteristics: amplitude-frequency response, beam pattern and voltage standing wave ratio.

articleTitle: Processing and Recognition of Small Unmanned Vehicles Sound Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Information characteristics of small unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) sound signals are analyzed and their descriptions for a quadcopter and monoplane are presented. The difference between signals of UAVs themselves and a noisy background becomes noticeable in the frequency domain. Research shows that signals energy spectra have a significant region of broadband noise and harmonic components with frequencies that are multiples of a rotational propellers speed. Even with averaging spectral estimates over ensemble of samples, harmonics are confidently observed. With the difference in modes of quadcopter engines the spectral maxima are divided into some portions, this can be one of the most important factors for UAV detection and classification systems. To provide their operation more close to a real time the fast algorithm is suggested. It includes the stage of forming primary recognition signs on the base of broadband sound signals spectra with harmonics and a specific noise. This description is compressed by the orthogonal transformation of its covariance matrix. Recognition of UAVs sound signals is according to the Dice similarity criteria in the compressed signal domain on using a small number of covariance matrix eigenvectors.

articleTitle: Using Azure Maching Learning Cloud Technology for Electric Machines Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Typically, the design procedure of an electrical machine consists of a multiple calculation of the dependencies between the main parameters, defined as a system of equations, empirical coefficients, graphical dependencies, which can be considered as design equations. An important task in the design of such complex systems is optimization with subsequent selection of the best candidate. In the article this task was solved with the help of Microsoft Azure Machine Learning Studio to predict the best configuration of an electric motor. Azure Machine Learning enables computers to learn from data and experiences and to act without being explicitly programmed. In developed Azure Machine Learning Studio application, as the searching algorithms Boosted Decision Tree Regression and Multiclass Neural Network were chosen. As a criterion of optimality, the maximum efficiency was selected. As the result of performed cloud calculations the optimal combination was found. Finally, the advantages of the Azure Cloud Platform compared to the tools that developers use on local PCs were shown.

articleTitle: Signal Statistic and Informational Parameters of Deterministic Chaos Transistor Oscillators for Infocommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper presents electrical circuits and mathematical models for two versions of a transistor Colpitts oscillator. The chaotic dynamic of these Colpitts oscillator versions has been researched. Ultra-wideband chaotic signals of these two Colpitts oscillator versions are applied practically in infocommunication circuits. Statistic and informational parameters of two Colpitts chaotic oscillator versions have been numerically calculated. Spectrum of Lyapunov exponents and chaotic signal cross correlation coefficients have been calculated as statistical parameters and characteristics. Entropy and fractal dimension of chaotic signals have been calculated as informational parameters.

articleTitle: Model of Reducing the Power Consumption for Node of Wireless Sensor Network in Embedded Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Model for reducing energy consumption in wireless sensor network is presented. Model of reducing the power consumption for node of wireless sensor network in embedded control systems. The operation of the wireless sensor network node is analyzed. Different models was analyzed for reducing energy consumption by node in wireless sensor network. The combination of a large number of nodes into a network, the requirements for minimizing the energy consumption of nodes and the network as a whole lead to the need for additional structural solutions when creating wireless sensor networks. The most important of these is network clustering, which also implies constant rotation of the cluster head node during the network life cycle. The proposed network structure with cluster unification in a piconet provides an advantage that is inherent in the hierarchical method of building wireless sensor networks.

Author Keywords: model of reducing the power consumption

articleTitle: Wireless Sensor Network for Communication Between Base Stations in the Local Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this work we developed and investigated an algorithm for constructing the routing table, the ability to adapt it depending on the network configuration changes. The experiment was carried out on real devices, which include RFM69HW transceiver and DWM1000 distance module. As a result of the experiment was obtained a route that allows you to cover all the base stations to collect data from mobile devices.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks for Image Denoising in Infocommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Image denoising is an urgent task that arises in image processing and transmission. Images are an integral part of content transmitted in infocommunication systems. Traditional statistical image filtering algorithms are not always effective for the random nature of the noise spectrum. Image denoising by convolutional neural networks is a modern and effective approach. The article is devoted to demonstrate the possibilities of using denoising convolutional neural networks to solve one of the most difficult tasks that developers face when performing the transfer of graphical information in infocommunication systems - denoising. Unlike traditional algorithms, denoising convolutional neural networks have architecture features that allow them to perform effectively image filtering with unknown noise level. It is suggested to use denoising convolutional neural networks to generate a correction signal in the infocommunication system, which transmits a noisy image. The article proposes to use denoising convolutional neural networks to generate a correction signal in the infocommunication system, which transmits a noisy image. Such pre-trained correction elements on a large and diverse image dataset can be easily fine-tuned for special filtering tasks.

articleTitle: Detection of Signals from a LoRa System Under Interference Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper examines the factors that affect the detection of signals in devices using modern LoRa technology to exchange information between devices that are part of the Internet of things in an interference environment. Features LoRa technology is a long range of information exchange in comparison with similar technologies, which is achieved through the spreading spectrum, the transmission of information in short packages and suppression of multipath signal propagation. The article notes the contribution of each factor to the quality of reception and studies the reception of the messages at the LoRa technology in a city with the significant interference that created by means of cellular communication and Wi-Fi devices.

articleTitle: Information Support of Remote Monitoring of Grain Crops Biomass Amount as the Feedstock to Load Biogas Reactors
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: It was shown a method of remote monitoring usage with the help of drones to evaluate the quantity of biomass to be used as a feedstock for biogas production as a part of information support system. It was proposed to take into account the climatic situational conditions when the growing wheat and maize grains is unprofitable but may be used for biogas production in biogas rectors during spring-summer period. The estimation of plants biomass state was carried out in a horizontal projection on the image to be obtained from the unmanned aerial vehicle during the period up to the first fertilization. Due to the individual analysis of the pixels of the image to be obtained in optical range using unmanned aerial vehicle, the filters parameters for the efficient identification of plants and additional objects were set. There were detected green and blue channels of the optical range as the most important for plants recognition. In the experimental field conditions, it was established that the horizontal area of the leaf area surface correlated with the amount of applied fertilizers. Such phenomenon may be used in constructing of improved spectral indices for the unmanned aerial vehicles.

articleTitle: The Effects of Queueing Algorithms on QoS for Real-Time Traffic in Process of Load Balancing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper considers both the basic mechanisms of queue management on the router and the principle of their operation. A comparative analysis of the following queuing mechanisms: FIFO (First-In First-Out), CQ (Custom Queuing), PQ (Priority Queuing), WFQ (Weighted Fair Queuing), CBWFQ (Class Based Weighted Fair Queuing) and LLQ (Low Latency Queuing) based on a number of parameters such as traffic volume, traffic type, service of mixed traffic, enable on router and number of queues was made. The results of analysis showed that each of the queuing mechanisms has its advantages when dealing with certain types of traffic. Whereas in the process of load balancing several interfaces of the router are involved simultaneously the choice of queuing mechanism on each of them will depend on QoS for real-time traffic. Thus in this work the effect of various queue management mechanisms (such as FIFO, PQ, CQ, WFQ, LLQ) to QoS for real-time traffic in the process of load balancing on the router in an IP network was also investigated. The simulation results showed that most of queuing mechanisms (except FIFO and CQ) in the process of load balancing allowed to provide high QoS for real time traffic by reducing the values of delays and jitter and a significant reduction of lost packets for such traffic flows. At the same time the results showed that in the load balancing process, the most efficient queues servicing mechanism is LLQ, which provides the lowest delay for VoIP and the end to-end delay commensurable with the PQ mechanism for video traffic.

articleTitle: Construction of the Criterion for the Agree of Expert Groups Estimates Based on Analysis of Interval Data
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article deals with the task of constructing the criterion of compatibility of experts` assessments within the group. It is shown the expediency to use the methods of analysis of interval data for construction of the specified criterion. On the example shown the effectiveness of the application of this criterion for selecting experts to further engage them in the process of project evaluation.

Author Keywords: methods of analysis of interval data

articleTitle: Ideology of Image Processing in Infocommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: We offer a methodology for image processing in infocommunication systems. For such processing, we consider the transformation of two-dimensional images into one-dimensional arrays. We also consider a two-dimensional image in the form of a set of different one-dimensional arrays and in the form of a one-dimensional continuous array. To detect information, we use the ideology of wavelets. To do this, we use the basic properties of the detailing wavelet-coefficients. We are expanding the basic properties for detailing wavelet-coefficients. We introduce new relationships to discover the information area. This allows us to isolate the contours of the image and compare the images with each other. To test the proposed approach, we used various real images.

articleTitle: Objective and Subjective Assessment of the Quality and Intelligibility of Noised Speech
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)

The behavior of the perceptual evaluation of speech quality (PESQ) measure is in good agreement with subjective estimates at SNR > 0 dB, whereas the tendency for such agreement is observed only for SNR >10 dB for frequency weighted segmental SNR (fwSNR) measure.

articleTitle: Tools for Investigating the Phishing Attacks Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: We are exploring new ways to analyze phishing attacks. To do this, we investigate the change in the dynamics of the power of phishing attacks. We also analyze the effectiveness of detection of phishing attacks. We are considering the possibility of using new tools for analyzing phishing attacks. As such tools, the methods of chaos theory and the ideology of wavelet coherence are used. The use of such analysis tools makes it possible to investigate the peculiarities of the phishing attacks occurrence, as well as methods for their identification effectiveness. This allows you to expand the scope of the analysis of phishing attacks. For analysis, we use real data about phishing attacks.

articleTitle: Infocomunication Technology for Determination of Coal Ash-Content on the Conveyor Line
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An infocommunication technology is offered for determining of coal ash-content on a conveyor by calculating according to mathematical models based on the initial data: the measured mass and volume of coal, and reference data for the properties of this coal grade is proposed. The technological scheme of the information-measuring system for determining the ash content of coal was improved, an algorithm and program interface are worked out, that will allow to promote mine coal quality. The task of creating a video surveillance system based on the state of the mining and technological object is solved on the example of a tape conveyor belt with the aim of further transferring information to the controller. The algorithm for realization of this problem, fragments of the software for its solution is given.

articleTitle: Some Issues of Dependencies of Loss from Technological Features of Optical Switches for Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper presents some questions related to losses caused by microelectromechanical switches in optical systems. We investigate the effects of strains in the positioner on SMA stresses (memory effect on the shape of the alloy) at low and high temperatures, and analyze losses of longitudinal, lateral and angular misalignments between two fibers for different dimensions of the mode field.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment of Corporate Infocommunication Systems Projects Using Bayesian Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article deals with the problem of risk assessment associated with the introduction of ERP-systems as the basic component of corporate infocommunication systems. This problem is very urgent, as the percentage of the failure of ERP systems implementation projects up to 70%. The proposed model allows to assess the overall risk of such projects as a combination of individual types of risk. They, in turn, are evaluated based on the definition of the probability of the risk factors. The mathematical apparatus used in this case is the Bayesian network of trust. The constructed model also makes it possible to recalculate the probabilities of individual nodes-factors based on the new facts about the state of the system. Application of the approach to the considered project of ERP implementation made it possible to identify the most significant risk factors: lack of a system development strategy, poor management of business process reengineering and inattention to staff resistance Allocation of groups of risk factors and evaluation of each of them on based probabilities more simple components make it possible to choice the strategy priority management development of ERP-systems.

articleTitle: Using Modern Architectures of Recurrent Neural Networks for Technical Diagnosis of Complex Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper provides an overview of modern recurrent neural network architectures that can be used as a model (building tool) for diagnosis and predicting of infocommunication systems elements. The paper presents arguments in favor of the using of recurrent neural networks. Also, to determine the best architecture, were conducted a number of experiments, and on the basis of the results, conclusions were made about the future prospects of using modern architecture.

articleTitle: Modeling of Boundary-Value Problems of Heat Conduction for Multilayered Hollow Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper proposes the solution of the boundary value problem for the distribution of a non-stationary temperature field along the thickness of a multilayer hollow cylinder. The basis of the solution is the reduction method, the quasi-derivative concept, the modified Fourier method, and the problem of eigenvalues. The obtained analytical solution is modeled as a pseudocode and implemented on a specific numerical example.

articleTitle: Monitoring System and Fixed Communication on the Basis of Nanosatellites
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: To provide communication, satellites are widely used. The main characteristics of communication satellites are: coverage area, power consumption, frequency range, number of telephone channels, service life, cost, height above the Earth’s surface, weight. The article compares the main characteristics of the satellites of Iridium and Inmarsat systems. The principles of building a launch vehicle in terms of the cost of launching satellites are analyzed. The preferences of building satellite systems based on clusters of nanosatellites are substantiated.

articleTitle: Models of Assessment and Analysis in Security Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Modern conditions for the systems functioning requires the development of qualitatively new security technologies. This is due to the emergence of specific risks and threats, increased probability and the number of speculative attacks, a low rate of an adaptive response formation. In the paper, models for assessing and analyzing the level of security are proposed, which, based on principal component methods, canonical correlations, cluster analysis, neural-fuzzy modeling, classification trees, improve the quality of decisions in the security management system in conditions of incompleteness and heterogeneity of information, the hybrid systems of indicators were used.

Author Keywords: security, system, assessment, level, main components, canonical correlations, cluster analysis, neural-fuzzy modeling, classification trees

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Radar Control of Airspace with the Multilateration System Use
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: It was done the analysis possibility of multilateration system use in conjunction with the existing radar facilities during radar control of the airspace. It was given the possible variants of detection, determination of coordinates and accompaniment of air objects that seek to be unnoticed or to carry out mimicry. Was reviewed the information capabilities of the multilateration system. The directions of the combination of possibilities of the multilateration system and information from the existing radar means were determined. It was considered the possibilities of obtaining data from the multilateration system in radio technical units. As receivers of the multilateration system, were use the ADS-B system receivers was proposed. The principle of operation of the distance-range method, which underlies the operation of the multilateration system, was considered in determining the coordinates of air objects. It was given the features and limitations on the use of information from the multilateration system.

articleTitle: Determining the Optimum Number of Single Operator Controlled Unmanned Aerial Vehicles for NPP Monitoring Missions: Human Error Issues
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An approach to determining the optimum number of single operator controlled unmanned aerial vehicles for NPP monitoring missions are suggested. The approach takes into account operator errors and wireless links equipment failures. In the approach, Human-machine system Operator - Fleet of unmanned aerial vehicles is considered as a queuing system. An example of using the approach to determining the optimum number of single operator controlled Spectator-M unmanned aerial vehicles for Zaporizhzhia NPP monitoring missions is presented. The results obtained are analysed and discussed.

articleTitle: Application of the Photoplethysmography Technique to Complex Wireless Diagnostic the Functional State of the Human Body
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article considers the possibility of developing wearable gloves, which, based on the method of the photoplethysmography, realize the receiving of several important diagnostic parameters. This will replace several diagnostic sensors with several photoplethysmographic. This technology will make it possible to implement complex diagnostics of a person's state even at a great distance from doctors using Bluetooth wireless technologies and the Internet. The article reviews the literature on the topic of photoplethysmographic method of screening diagnostics. Based on the analysis of the principles of the photoplethysmography and components of the photoplethysmographic signal, it were determined additional possibilities of the photoplethysmographic method, such as the allocation the respiration curve from the photoplethysmographic signal and the measuring the pulse transit time. It is proposed a unique universal device that combines several photoplethysmographic functions simultaneously: registration of heart rate, breath curve registration, and the recording of pulse transit time. This will allow one device to calculate the pulse wave velocity and the Hildebrand index. These characteristics are very valuable for complex diagnostic of the functional state of physiological systems of the human body. That will significantly expand the possibilities of modern photoplethysmography. To improve the photoplethysmographic device, it is proposed to use the most advanced developments of wearable wireless sensors.

articleTitle: Application of Clustering Methods in Radar Signals Recognition
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: One of the most principal function in the electronic intelligence system is gathering information from the entire electromagnetic spectrum and its analysis. The paper presents some aspects of radar signals recognition in electronic intelligence systems by using clustering algorithms. The basic concepts of this technique are described. The results obtained for nearest neighbour methods are provided. Clustering algorithm was tested for different distance measures.

articleTitle: Information Technologies of Processing Big Industrial Data and Decision-Making Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The scientific methods aimed at introducing of IT for processing large volumes of data with distributed infrastructure based on intelligent agents and parallel algorithms are considered. The emphasis is made on innovative methods based on intellectual agents and principles of Industry 4.0. The implementation and simulation of parallel algorithms for processing big data and decision-making trees are carried out.

articleTitle: Informativity of Association Rules from the Viewpoint of Information Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper information theory, in particular, mutual information is suggested as a possible basis for association rule quality assessment. Normally association rules are not considered to be associated with mutual information, although there are a lot of papers on the matter of association significance. We have introduced a new approach supported by precise mathematical formulas, which allows considering non-binary associations in the context of Shannon's theory. An overview of some parameters important for determining the importance of an association dependence has been presented. Complete mutual information that can be calculated as the sum of four addends has been investigated in the context of various requirements to association rule importance. It has been shown which of the requirements are met by the complete mutual information and which ones are met with one of the addends used to calculate it. The obtained results can be used for assessing association rules discovered in big data from the viewpoint of information theory.

Author Keywords: information theory; association rule; big data

articleTitle: Signal Denoising using Modified Complex SSA Method with Application to Frequency Estimation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The problem of denoising of the noisy signals is considered in the paper. The modification of the complex singular spectrum analysis (SSA) method for complex-valued signal model is presented. The application of the modified complex SSA method as preprocessing stage to subspace-based methods used for frequency estimation is considered. Possible applications of proposed approach in communication systems are considered. The feasible ways of further improving of proposed approach performance are considered. Simulation results confirm the effectiveness of using of the modified complex SSA. It is shown that the application of the modified SSA allows to improve the accuracy of frequency estimation.

articleTitle: New Phase Accumulator for Direct Digital Frequency Synthesizer
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Principles of construction of the direct digital frequency synthesizers were proposed. The proposed structure of the phase synthesizer accumulators based on Galois adders that will increase the bit range of syntheses and improve their frequency response range expansion in the direct digital synthesizers of signals. The functional circuit devices were proposed.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic Sensor Based on Liquid Crystal Substances for the Monitoring of Amino Acids
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Liquid crystal materials are successfully used in different branches of medicine. It was proposed using cholesteric-nematic mixtures as a sensitive element of optic sensor for amino acids (valine and serine). Amino acids while interacting with liquid crystal mixtures cause modifications in spectral characteristics of the material, which is the background for creation of a sensitive element of a sensor. Hardware design of optic sensor composition based on PSoC microcontroller has been elaborated for determination of amino acid concentrations with high accuracy. This solution enables to design a sensor with high resistance to external disturbances.

articleTitle: Improvement for Ergonomic Quality of Man-Machine Interaction in Automated Systems based on the Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A mathematical model of optimization of the man-machine system by the description of the functional algorithm in a form of an event graph was worked out. The task of ergonomic design is reduced to the problem of linear programming. As an objective function, the probability of error-free execution of the operation algorithm is used, and as constraints, the restriction on the mathematical expectation of the execution time and resource consumption. Mathematical model the optimal variant of human-machine interaction allows you to choose. The model will be useful for designers of automated systems.

articleTitle: Towards Model Checking of the Internet of Things Solutions Interoperability
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The Internet of Things paradigm implementation is infeasible without the interoperability aspect fulfillment. Both the diversity of “smart” devices involved and the difference of Internet protocols used make it a challenging task to achieve the true interoperability. Moreover, there is still an open question concerning the consistency of certain potentially interoperable Internet of Things solution. With this statement in mind, the approach to the Internet of Things solutions consistency checking has been proposed. These solutions are assumed to be implemented on the basis of Web Services. The proposed approach has been grounded on the concept of “action” providing the scalable and reconfigurable way for formal model description. To describe the framework, a Kripke structure has been used. The applicability of proposed approach has been discussed on the basis of smart home scenario as a case study. To formulate the recommendations regarding the automation of model checking procedure, two opposite approaches to state space search have been contemplated - the Breadth-first Search and the Depth-first Search.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Process of Selecting of the IoT-Platform for the Specific Technical Solution IoT-Sphere
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the paper proposes a method for increasing the efficiency of the decision-making process for the selection of software and hardware platforms for the implementation of projects in the IoT-sphere that taking into account maximum functionality and acceptable cost. The efficiency of the process of selecting an appropriate platform can be achieved by minimizing the time it takes to select an IoT platform. The implementation of the method involves the creation of an automated system for selecting IoT-platforms that interacts with the classification database. The procedure for creation of a database of classification characteristic of IoT-platforms, which represented on the market, is formalized. For creation database is using the facet classification method. There is developed the procedure for creation facet formulas that is taking into account the functional features of IoT-platforms. As a criterion for selecting IoT-platforms there is used a set of user-defined parameters.The principle of work the automated system is formalized in the form of an algorithm.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of MIMO
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Nowadays, unmanned aerial systems are widely using to solve various tasks. The main element of any unmanned aviation complex is controlling and data transmission channels. Existing scientific achievements do not fully take into consideration the effect of various destabilizing factors on the impedance of control and data transmission channels. In order to clarify the degree of influence of various destabilizing factors on the noise immunity of control channels and data transmission in the work, the authors developed a mathematical model of the MIMO system. The proposed model allows estimating the noise immunity of the MIMO system of unmanned aviation complexes under the influence of destabilizing factors. The difference between the developed model and the existing ones, which determines its novelty is that the proposed model is based on the new analytical relations for calculating the MIMO immunity index, which takes into consideration different types of intentional noise, selective signal fading, Doppler effect, inter-symbol interference, phase jitter and efficiency of the calculation of low signal/noise ratio in the channel. Using the proposed model allows analyzing the noise immunity of the MIMO system of unmanned aeronautical complexes and taking into consideration the influence of destabilizing factors. The proposed mathematical model of the MIMO system should be used to analyze the state of channels of unmanned aerial systems and to determine measures aimed at increasing the noise immunity of unmanned aerial systems channels.

articleTitle: Prediction of Introduced Distortions Parameters in Lossy Image Compression
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper addresses a problem of predicting parameters of distortion introduced by lossy image compression. Such a prediction is needed to produce a desired quality of compressed images quickly. It is shown that mean square error and peak signal-to-noise ratio can be predicted with high accuracy if images subject to compression are practically noise-free an with appropriate accuracy if images subject to compression are noisy. Approaches to improve accuracy of parameter prediction in compressing of noisy images are proposed and compared. Practical recommendations are given.

articleTitle: Features of Dynamic Modeling of Routers Operation Modes in Simulink
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this article, features of simulation modeling of various routers interfaces operating modes in telecommunication networks are considered. For analysis, the model is using the Simulink package integrated into the MATLAB environment. The proposed model makes it possible to verify the adequacy of the corresponding analytical models in terms of quality of service indicators, as well as to compare the efficiency of solving queue management and routing problems.

articleTitle: Simple Princeples of Antennas Modification Based on Metamaterials (Survey)
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the paper the simple samples of the basic metaconstructions are considered. Such constructions allow enhancing the radiation properties as well as providing the possibility of needed characteristics of antennas. It is possible due to unusual properties of such materials which are the negative value of permittivity and/or permeability that can be achieved by the special design of material elements and their shape. There are many kinds of those metamaterials including split ring resonators, wire medium of different structures, metashells etc. Their utilization or combination of such metacomponents for the modification of different radiators allows to change the operation frequency, radiation pattern and gain as well as their directivity.

articleTitle: IT Service Quality Management Based on Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: nowadays business cannot survive without integration with information technologies. That is why there is an emerging need in implementation and provisioning of IT services to end users and corporate users. However, with information technologies used business faces new challenges like appropriate and instant reaction to faults in process of provisioning of those services. That is why it is important to have automation tools for intelligent maintenance of service quality. This need is explained by the tight connection between resources required for providing services and their quality. In this paper, methods for quality evaluation and quality management were proposed. Quality evaluation according to proposed method works through the neural network classifier and management method uses fuzzy logic as a background framework. Experimental results have proved performance of the method.

articleTitle: Complex Parameters Evaluation of Wavelet Transformation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted to increasing of analysis and diagnostics efficiency for various nature objects by means of developing methods and information technology for complex parameters evaluation of discrete wavelet transformation. The approaches are practically applied in medical (cardiology) and engineering (milling) industries in the following tasks such as waviness and roughness allocation of metal surface profile, detection of the basic electrocardiogram complexes.

articleTitle: Mobile Infocommunication System for AdaptiveAnalysing of the Biomedical Indicators and Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Use of personal gadgets and mobile applications to control functional state of human health is popular approach for today. To get the aim still a lot of problems accompany these processes. This paper will present one of the possible approaches to combine external gadgets, mobile applications and client service platform. It is developed information platform that consists of biomedical processing modules: gadget for heart rate measurement, data base, determination of heart rate variability and decision module. The platform includes soft to transport analysis results to the medical server. Physician decision is transferred to a patient. Paper discusses possible ways of the development m-health medicine.

articleTitle: Investigation of Potential Opportunities for LoRaWAN Technology in Conditions of Urban Construction on the Example of Pycom Modules
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article describes a principle of operation and main technical characteristics of modern open network protocol LoRaWan on the example of Pycom modules. LoRaWAN is the perspective energy-efficient technology of long-range distance significant advantages over Wi-Fi and cellular networks for “Internet of Things” and others service. The article shows the experimental researches dependence of received signal level and Signal-to-noise ratio on different floors of a building. Experimental researches dependence of received signal level and Signal-to-noise ratio on distance in conditions of open terrain and in urban conditions. Based on the results of exploratory studies, the maximum range of more than 10 floors in the building and in free space up to 5 km.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Method of Load Balancing Routing on SDN Controllers with Multicore Architecture
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper the hierarchical method of load balancing routing on SDN controllers with multicore architecture is proposed. The implementation of a two-level hierarchy of calculations is proposed on the SDN controllers with multicore architecture where the lower level is responsible for calculating the routing variables, and the upper level is for solutions obtained from the lower level coordination. In proposed multicore architecture of SDN controller the border routers of the network will be matched by the controller core, which performs the function of calculation the routing variables. The separate core of the controller will act as a coordinator with function of link overload prevention. Application of the proposed method allows to increase the scalability of routing solutions, reduce the amount of service information that circulates in the network, as well as reduce the complexity of the whole method.

articleTitle: Analyzing and Comparison of NoSQL DBMS
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this article we described the main characteristics and types of NoSQL technology while approaching different aspects that highly contribute to the use of those systems. Also, three different types of application were considered and based on them several NoSQL databases were analyzed. According to the results, we summarize which databases are more preferable to solve specific type of problem.

articleTitle: Software-Controlled Network SDN Reliability Calculation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article discusses the technology of the software-controlled SDN network (Software-Defined Networking), presents several types of a rchitecture and calculates network reliability. Formulas and examples of reliability indicators calculation for each network component are given. Pros and cons of this technology are examined. Reliability characteristics of SDN network a re analyzed. The methods of using reliability theory in practice, at the SDN object and with NAT are considered. A model for calculating the reliability of this architecture is proposed. For future designing system development for monitoring programs of any objects, which are 3. 5G (HSPA +) 4G, 5G networks in this case. The reliability of these standards should be equal to the reliability ratio of the standard that is being developed at the same time with other standards.

articleTitle: Applying of Genetic Algorithm in Clustering Methods for Communication Networks Planning
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A combined algorithm for automated finding the optimal configuration of cluster distribution is presented. Clusters are considered as idealized subnets of a multi-level computer network, which can have different methods of data transferring. The use of genetic algorithm is considered as a method for finding the best solution in a multidimensional problem with a large number of local minimums. In assessing the optimality, the distance from the center of the cluster to the place of its location brought into line to the expenses of its operation. The combined algorithm was software-implemented and was analyzed by results of solving a particular problem of transferring data.

articleTitle: Signals and Images Protection Based on Ateb-Transforms in Infocommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A new method for constructing a digital watermarking based on the Ateb-functions for infocommunication systems is proposed. Presented method is a type of generalization the well-known method, which is based on Fourier transform. Equations for two-dimensional direct and inverse discrete Ateb transform were presented. Recorded formulas are used to create the new method for embed an electronic digital signature into an image. To verify the stability of the digital watermark, experiments with simulation of various types of attacks on the image were carried out. Sustainability means the ability to read and identify a digital watermark after an attack. Experiments were carried out on known test images from accessible databases. The following types of attacks were performed: resizing the file, changing the color depth of the image, image rotation, image compression. The criterion for the presence of a digital watermark is correlation, Conducted experiments show that the developed method is resistant to most types of attacks. The results are presented in a table form. The proposed method relates to image protection methods, based on the hiding of data in a frequency domain for the implementation of protection of information during its transmission in communication channels. Scope of digital watermarking use-electronic documents transmitted via computer networks. The advantage of proposal method of protection and identification is the relatively lower cost of their implementation in relation to the level of security of the document. The method can be applied to protect also audio and video files.

articleTitle: The Indirect Method of Steganographic Embedding of Data in an Image Container Based on the Information of the Contour
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article discusses issues related to the use of methods of digital steganography for information security in systems of critical appointment. Due to the necessity of concealing data in an image. The main disadvantages of the existing methods of embedding in the image container. The issues of JPEG image compression for digital steganography. Proposed allocation of sustainable regions in the attacking effects on the basis of the moving mask. Shown the mathematical apparatus for masking images by the method of Sobel. Developed an indirect method of steganography is hiding data in blocks which contain information about the circuit.

articleTitle: Implementation of Infocommunication Technologies at Condominium Community Level to Increase the Involvement of Citizens in the IGovernment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The essence, purposes and advantages of the creation of digital space in Ukraine are described. It was grounded the necessity of implementation of infocommunication technologies at the low level of hierarchy (condominiums). The main objectives of the implementation of infocommunication systems at various levels of the municipal economy and management, starting with micro groups such as condominiums and ending with city councils are defined. The concept of implementation an information system, that can be applied at the level of the housing and communal sector, in particular at the level of the condominium, was proposed in the paper. Different implementation aspects of the proposed level of the infocommunication system as part of the IGovernment system have been considered. The scheme of implementation of infocommunication technologies for condominium, which consist of five stages, is proposed in the article and each stage is described in details. The approach, which is oriented on micro-level is oriented on improvement the delivery and dissemination of digital public services, as a part of the iGovernement system.

articleTitle: Using Data Mining for Intelligence-Led Policing and Crime Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article is devoted to a review and perspectives of using data mining methods in the work of criminal analysts in the national police by the process of developing and implementing proactive police activities for the prevention and investigation crimes. It also describes data mining tools for improving the effectiveness of information-analytical work of the law-enforcement agencies through the creation of automated intelligent technological tools. The operative part of the article outlines the basic principles, models and technologies that specialized software is used to support the analytical work of criminal analysts.

Author Keywords: the visual analysis of the crime

articleTitle: Method of VoIP Network Performance Optimizing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Existing approaches to routing calls in Voice Over IP networks interacting with several IP-telephony providers are considered. The mathematical model of voice calls routing and its analysis and optimization have been described. Method of Voice Over IP network performance optimizing based on voice call routing automation and core IP-network reorganization to increase the cost / quality ratio of Voice Over IP communication which gives an average of more than 20% increase in quality indices without a significant increase of conversation cost has been developed.

articleTitle: Information Technology to Determine the Effectiveness of Advertising Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The features of information printed advertising (newspaper and magazine) are described. The factors that affect the effectiveness of advertising printed communication, the definition of the links between them are analyzed. Based on methods of system analysis and mathematical modeling of hierarchies in the final result, a hierarchy of factors of influence on the effectiveness of advertising communication was created. The expediency of taking into account certain factors during media planning of this means of advertising communication is substantiated.

articleTitle: Estimation of DVB-S2 ACM Mode Performance for Broadband Satellite Infocommunication Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article is devoted to the analysis of the characteristics of adaptive satellite infocommunication systems and contains the results of authors' research in this direction. The main purpose of these studies is to propose possible way for increasing the efficiency of satellite-based infocommunication video systems with adaptive modulation and channel coding, taking into account the features of algorithms that used in such type of systems and possible distortions when decoding at the MPEG video stream level. To implement this the simulation model of DVB-S2 system with adaptive encoding and modulation was developed in Matlab / Simulink mathematical simulation environment. As result of simulation, performance of the SNORE algorithm, recommended by the ETSI standard for the adaptive coding and modulation mode, was analyzed, possible ways of increasing its characteristics were proposed. The obtained results can be used during the technical maintenance and link planning in case of usage of DVB-S2 systems for infocommunication applications, as well as during further research aimed at increasing the efficiency of systems of such type.

articleTitle: Ontological Approach to the Construction of Multi-Agent Systems for the Maintenance Supporting Processes of Production Equipment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
