abstract: The paper is devoted to the application of ontological engineering for the synthesis of supporting systems for the maintenance of production equipment as a conceptual basis for a multi-agent system. It is proposed to increase the efficiency of production at industrial enterprises by ensuring the reliability of production equipment by developing and implementing technology for information support of its maintenance processes in the aspect of providing spare parts. At the same time, efficiency is provided by reducing the time spent on urgent repairs of production equipment. The method of informational support of providing spare parts processes for production equipment of an industrial enterprise is described, which, unlike existing ones, makes it possible to determine the range of spare parts in an enterprise warehouse, and to order spare parts on the basis of Internet technology of things. It is shown the structure of the data on industrial situations ontological model, which occurred as a result of production equipment failures, that ensured the construction of appropriate information structures on the basis of a precedent approach. It is proposed to use the technology of intelligent agents to implement information support for the technical diagnostics of production equipment as elements of the Internet of things conception.

articleTitle: Using SDR Technology in Mobile TroposcatterCommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper analyzes the possible concept of practical implementation of modern mobile universal radio relay and troposcatter communication system with adaptation time, frequency, spatial and polarization parameters. The results choise communication protocols of universal radio relay-troposcatter communications system and preliminary open path testing this communication system are discussed.

Author Keywords: radio Relay and Troposcatter Communications Systems

articleTitle: Practical Application of Formal Representation of Information for Intelligent Radar Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Conceptual and theoretical foundations of the given paper are based on the methods of logical analysis, the theory of intelligence and algebra of finite predicates for the development of the method for formalizing the processes of perception and transformation of signals and signal images; methods of the theory of image recognition for constructing deciding rules; methods of spectral analysis for the creation of a model for detecting and recognizing the signals of objects in radar spectral way; comparative identification methods for creating a spatial-semantic model; methods of probability theory for evaluation the effectiveness of developed models and method. For practical realization of the developed models the methods of mathematical modeling are used.

articleTitle: Modification of the IEEE 802.16 Standard in Application to the "Distributed Satellite"
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The WiMAX network modification to adapt the "distributed satellite" specifications was considered. The measuring approach based on the WiMAX wideband access mobile network utilization was proposed for evaluation of micro satellites and cubes-satellites relative position during their clustering flight in close proximity to one another.

articleTitle: Research of Non-Markovian Queuing Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article presents models of mathematical multiplexing and demultiplexing of flows, as well as the expressions for determining the numerical characteristics of the intervals distribution in the output flow from the queuing system (QS). Together they allow us to write the equations of equilibrium with respect to the mean values and variance in the time intervals distributions between neighboring states in queuing networks in case of random receiving flows patterns and service time. QS M-/M-/1 with a delay in time, H2/H2/1 and H2/M/1 are considered to be the nodes of the network. With general assumptions about the probability of time distribution between neighboring states in the input flows and service time at the nodes, the proposed approach allows to determine average values and variances of time intervals between all the states of queuing network flows, as well as all the probabilistic properties of such networks. The approach can also be extended, if necessary, to third moments. From the perspective of probability theory, this will be more accurate than the calculation at the level of two moments of the distributions. Having incomplete information on the patterns of time intervals distribution, the proposed approach may be acceptable for the analysis of the performance of non-Markovian queuing networks.

articleTitle: Method of Fault Tolerance Evaluation in Conditions of Destabilizing Factors Influence in Infocommunication Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper, a method for estimating the fault tolerance of an infocommunication network under conditions of destabilizing factors is proposed, which characterizes the dependence of the effective action coefficient of the infocommunication network on the number of routes, which in turn will allow estimating the network stability under the influence of various destabilizing factors, for example, attacks. The obtained dependence of the network effective network factor on the number of routes allows to determine the rational range of the number of required routes under the influence of the destabilizing factors. The results of the study of the proposed method for assessing fault tolerance will make it possible to justify the requirements for the topology of the infocommunication network and to the choice of means and ways to protect it from failing factors.

articleTitle: Multilayer Access for Database Protection
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The analysis of modern database management systems and their security allows highlighting the main problem-poor protection against loss of user authentication data and the use of discretionary access control mechanism to the management function. Multilayer approach to the user's authorization in the database management systems as the main stage of protection is proposed. The modular system of authorization system divides in 3 layers. First layer is getting access to the user rights which can give user simple access to read database information. Second layer is getting access to the redactor rights. Third layer is getting personal administrator access to the all rights in database. Access to each subsequent layer is possible only after the getting the previous one. Every layer uses security mechanisms, which can help creator of database to protect his database from nonauthorized access.

articleTitle: Chua Circuit with Several Voltage Sources
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Secured data transmission is one of the main branches of modern chaotic systems' usages. The paper deals with the study and usage of the Chua circuit model with a voltage source in each branch. Analysis of this model allows everybody to define preferable places for a set-up voltage source in the Chua circuit. Mentioned places make it possible to reduce Chua model and to simplify controller design which synchronizes two Chua circuits by using master-slave control technique. The high quality of this synchronization is granted by using sliding mode control algorithms. Usage of these algorithms allows us to compensate nonlinearity of considered circuit and changing of its parameters. We use the node-voltage method for developing the Chua circuit model with several voltage sources. Then we analyze the developed model and find that it is the best choice to use voltage sources which are connected in a serial way with capacitors. At third, we develop ta Chua circuit's interval model and use it to compensate nonlinearity of Chua diode. Then we write down full and reduced state space equations for the Chua circuit. At fifth, we use reduced interval equations to design a controller which performs synchronization of two Chua circuit.

articleTitle: Texture Spectrum of High-Definition Images with Frequency-Dependent Quantization
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper presents the results of measuring the signal-to-noise ratio at the boundary of object contours in high-definition images after compression of the original digital stream based on the Fourier transform and the discrete cosine transform. It is shown that when choosing the threshold for limiting the spectral components of the image, one should not only focus on the frequency, but also take into account the magnitude of the differences in the brightness signal in areas of low-contrast textures. We examined seven different quantization matrices of the spectral coefficients and compared the achievable compression ratios of the digital stream for the four options for selecting the threshold of the constraint. The results of the influence of the original word length of the luminance and color difference signals on the qualitative parameters of the reconstructed image for different quantization matrices are presented.

articleTitle: Intelligent Algorithms of Processing of Information in the Production Entomophages
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The work is devoted to the problem of the use of intelligent information processing algorithms, in particular cognitive analysis and fuzzy logic, in the production of entomophages, which, from the position of the system approach, represents a complex dynamic system with control, contains a set of basic, auxiliary and service processes related to information interdependencies, and is characterized by stochasticity, multidimensionality of input and output parameters, ambiguous behavior of the biological object; the scientific novelty work of the is that, using the cognitive approach and the theory of fuzzy logic to the simulation of complex systems, in order taking into account the results of analysis of a large number and large volumes of information flows in the production of entomophage Habrobracon hebetor proposed the method of cognitive analysis of information, consisting of a cognitive model of host insect (Ephestia kuehniella) production and a fuzzy cognitive map for controlling the influence of technological parameter on the quality indicators of the Ephestia kuehniella; to create fuzzy cognitive map been used Fuzzy Logic Toolbox Matlab and and a system of fuzzy conclusion by Mamdani; the proposed method allows with sufficient accuracy to formulate control decisions in conditions of uncertainty of a biological object.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Parameters of Selective Signals Using Interpolation Quadratic Spline Functions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An estimate is made of the maximum parameters of the total energy of the selective signal, which is constructed using a quadratic spline. The smallest and largest value of the function that describes the selective signal in a given range of values is obtained. The findings make it possible to stage, to determine the optimal waveform design network technology specified in accordance with the chosen criteria and provide the necessary energy signal indicators.

articleTitle: Formation of the Method of Branched its Power Distribution by Activities and Specifics of Work
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: There are specified key aspects of Information and Telecommunication systems (ITS) load balancing. Considered work peculiarities of the systems witch are using multiprocessor servers and multi-core processes implementation. Analyzed distributed information systems technology, constituents of security estimation are conducted from external influence. Construction algorithm of classification is offered to information and telecommunication systems. The load distribution model of network in distributed information systems built on the basis of corresponding mathematical model. Efficiency of this system functioning is shown during work of the information and telecommunication system infrastructure while it's in the emergency state. Created technologic complex of security estimations for the difficult distributed information and telecommunication systems in the conditions of cyber threat. Developed testing and estimation algorithm of cyber threat signatures determination in mathematical model and was tested on the network resources of the information and telecommunication system.

articleTitle: The Method for Ensuring the Survivability of Distributed Computing in Heterogeneous Computer Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Nowadays specialists in distributed computing try to reduce execution time for complex calculations. One of the tasks about increasing the efficiency of distributed computing is - ensure survivability, which consists in the fastest possible restoration of the distributed program system in the event of the failure of some hardware resources. This article is devoted to the study the issues of ensuring the functional reliability of software. The rollback process formalization for survivability of a distributed computing are presented. The rules of resource management are formulated. Method of providing survivability by memory dump of software components was developed. This method can be implemented as a separate middleware or by embedding it in distributed software, for example, as a library of functions.

articleTitle: An Approach to Search for Multi-Round Differential Characteristics of Cypress-256
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this work it is considered the differential cryptanalysis of the lightweight block cipher Cypress that was recently developed in Ukraine. Firstly, a cryptanalysis model for Cypress block cipher is introduced. Then a method for searching for multi-round differential characteristics for Cypress-256 is proposed. The method includes the construction of a big set of one-round characteristics with further combination of them. The application of the proposed method reveled no match within the constructed set that is good for Cypress-256 from the point of view of its strength to differential cryptanalysis. The analysis of constructed set showed that inputs with the minimal Hemming weight are not always leads to high probable characteristics (especially, multi-round ones) and the most popular characteristics with a high probability have inputs with 5-6 active bits.

articleTitle: Informational Training System Mindgate
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The question about distance learning systems and their modernization is discussed in this work. Modern systems do not give the opportunity of interactive integration into the studying and design/user interface/possibilities are not required. It was the cause of low study efficiency. The lack of online platform does not allow getting the homework centrally (relatively to the specialization of students). Nowadays in 2nd and 3rd world countries distance educational systems do not provide competently work about giving the learning materials. The system that will allow solving these problems is described below.

articleTitle: Mobile Combined Microwave Telecommunication System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this article is shown that one of the solutions from terrestrial communication types can be the deployment of beyond line-of-sight (BLOS) communications, consisting of mobile digital troposcatter stations. The binding to fixed-point nodes is carry out by means of line-of-sight (LOS) communications, consisting of mobile digital radio relay stations. However, the combined systems that would be offer on a common mobile transport base and implementation of the both solutions (LOS + BLOS) is the modern way of development terrestrial microwave telecommunication systems. The receiver-transmitting microwave path of the proposed mobile combined microwave telecommunication system is designed. The suppression of the mirror frequency signal in the balance type mixer by the phase method is investigated. In this case, two balance type mixer schemes are proposed. In both schemes uses broadband slot waveguide bridge, which has the dielectric plate in the slot.

articleTitle: Fast Algorithms for Deterministic Non-Equidistant Digital Filtering of Signals in the Time Domain
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted fast algorithms for deterministic non-equidistant digital filtering of signals in the time domain. The algorithms are based on codes with minimal aperiodicity. Deterministic non-equidistant sampling of signals in the time domain allowed merging the positive properties of both periodic and stochastic sampling processes. The algorithms perform address recirculation to computing of convolution operator and allow the comb characteristics of the filters to be constructed using the thinning procedure for partial products. The algorithms allow obtaining convolution values with significantly smaller hardware and time costs. In addition, the algorithms allow to easily parallelizing the structure of the computing device. The presented algorithms are convenient for hardware calculation of the spectrum because there are required one multiplier block for many channels and one control device, which reduces hardware costs. The algorithms can be used in the task of real time authentication of user electronic devices and cyber-physical devices, including intelligent sensors, based on the individual characteristics of the sensor electrical noise signal.

Author Keywords: parallelizing the structure of the computing

articleTitle: Securing Computer Hardware on the Base of Reference Monitor Obfuscation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Widespread outsourcing of integrated circuits fabrication increases the vulnerability to security threats. In this paper, we address approach that incorporates hardware design obfuscation scheme to protect a design against various forms of attacks. Hardware obfuscation is a technique by which an integrated circuit is modified to intentionally conceal its functionality and schematic. We consider hardware security through the reference monitor obfuscation. We obscure the connectivity of reference monitor so that an attacker cannot gain its functionality and original structure.

articleTitle: Analysis and Improvement of Service Quality in Special Purpose Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article examines the main destabilizing factors, as well as the parameters of the special purpose network, which affect the quality of service of this network. An assessment of the negative level of impact on the quality of service of individual network characteristics was made. Possible technical and protocol mechanisms for eliminating the negative impact are suggested.

articleTitle: Experimental Studies of Ransomware for Developing Cybersecurity Measures
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The study presents the results of the experiment on static and dynamic analysis of Petya / ExPetr ransomware. Methods of ransomware distribution, its actions when entering the information system: system scanning, file encryption, Master Boot Record modification and others are considered. The analysis of the ransomware allows to understand its principle of performance and will be used to develop a methodology for forensic study of cyber-attacks that implement ransomware.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Resource Blocks Allocation Balancing Model in the LTE Downlink Using RAT 1 with Existing Solutions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Comparative analysis of the balancing model of resource blocks allocation in the LTE downlink using RAT 1 with existing algorithms is done. The proposed model allow to considerably decrease the computational complexity of finding final solutions on resource block allocation among user equipments in the LTE network due to linear nature of the obtained optimization problem of mixed integer programming. Comparative analysis has shown the effectiveness of the balancing model, especially in a complex signal-to-noise conditions, the presence of heterogeneous requirements for the type and level of the service quality. It is shown that the proposed time-frequency resource management model has provided the highest efficiency under conditions of QoS requirements of user requests, comparable to or exceeding the bandwidth of the LTE downlink.

articleTitle: Effective Coding Method of Video Frames in Infocommunications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An approach to encoding information elements of a sequence of predicted frames is considered. Within this approach, proposed the method that uses the features of the information component.The proposed method is aimed to reducing the inter-frame integrated structural redundancy taking into account the features of the information component of the differentially-described spectrograms. The processing of spectrograms performs according to the block principle, which makes it possible to reduce the number of processing algorithmic operations, to reveal additional structural elements, and to reduce the processing complexity and reduce the amount of overhead information. Formation of a system of expressions for determining the code value of the informative component is carried out within the framework of the structural approach based on code constructions of positional numbers. The two-stage synthesis of the system of relations for the construction of codograms is considered. First, the definition of an informative differential-described spectral function of the code in the form of a sequence in a single-base positional space with a fixed base value is performed. At the final stage of the synthesis, the condition for the lack of equality between adjacent elements of an informative differential-described spectrogram taken into account.

articleTitle: Number of Loops in Elastic Scale-Free Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Model of scale-free networks with non-unit elasticity has been investigated. Applying the concept of non unit elasticity, i.e. the concept of different relative growth rates for links and nodes, makes it possible to generate scale free models for dense networks. An analytic expression for the number of loops as a function of network size has been found. As it was shown, the number of loops follows a power law with scaling factor linearly depends on elasticity factor. Numerical simulation was made and numerical results are in accordance with analytic ones.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Single-Channel Infocommunication Node with Several Packet Flows
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Despite some shortcomings of a mathematical apparatus of queuing theory, it nevertheless remained as a simple technology of the solution of problems of infocommunication nodes modeling. In this work it will be reviewed an example of the solution of such task for single-channel network node in case, that on his entrance incomes the superposition of equal priority streams of packages with various intensity. In this work, we obtain relations for calculating the distribution of states of a Markov system in the stationary condition. Possessing information on the distribution of stationary states, it is possible to calculate the quality of service parameters in the nodes of telecommunication networks: the average delay in the node, the average queue length, and the average number of packet losses. Quality of service parameters can be calculated for each of the streams entering the superposition, and for the composite flow.

articleTitle: Using Queuing Theory Methods for Processing Correlated Information Flows
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Here considered a queuing system with autocorrelated inter-arrival time and service. Limitations of the queuing theory for such systems consist in the use of only independent time intervals. Here we consider a general approach for processing correlated traffic in the node represented as general queuing system. Using renewal process, we show that presence of correlation in the sequences of inter-arrival time and the service time of significantly reduces the average waiting time in the queue.

articleTitle: Research of Statistical Properties of Stream Symmetric Ciphers
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In recent years, numerous studies of stream symmetric ciphers in Ukraine are continuing, the main purpose of which is to argue the principles of creating a new cryptographic algorithm, which can be based on the national standard. One of the essential aspects in choosing from many alternatives is the statistical properties of the output pseudorandom sequence (key stream). In this paper, the results of comparative studies of statistical properties of output sequences, which are formed by various stream ciphers, in particular, by world-known algorithms Enocoro, Decim, Grain, HC, MUGI, Mickey, Rabbit, RC-4, Salsa20, SNOW2.0, Sosemanuk, Trivium and the Ukrainian cryptographic algorithm Strumok, that was developed in recent years, are presented. For comparative studies, the NIST STS method was used, according to which experimental studies are performed in 15 statistical tests, the purpose of which is to determine the randomness of the output binary sequences. Each of the tests is aimed at studying certain vulnerabilities of the generator, that is, points to the potential usage of different methods of cryptographic analysis. Although each of the considered streaming encryption algorithms has been studied, we have carried out a statistical test of the generated pseudorandom sequences under equal conditions and with identical initial parameters, that is, our results allow us to perform a comparative analysis of ciphers and to justify the best of statistical properties. The estimates presented in the article, as expected, confirmed the high statistical security indexes of modern ciphers. In addition, according to the results of experimental research, it was found that the new Ukrainian development - the stream cipher Strumok does not yield to the best world algorithms in the statistical properties of the initial sequences.

articleTitle: Research of Dual Systems H2/M/1 and M/H2/1 with Exponential and Hyperexponential Input Distributions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper, we present comparative results of publications on dual systems H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/M/1 and M/H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/1 with hyperexponential input distributions of the second order. By Kendall's definition, these systems belong to the classes G/M/1 and M/G/1, respectively. The distribution of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> includes 3 unknown parameters and can therefore be approximated at the level of the first three moments. The solution for the average waiting time for the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/M/1 system depends on the three moments of the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> distribution. The average waiting time for the system M/H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/1 does not depend on the 3rd moment of the distribution of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, but depends only on the first two moments and completely coincides with the Polyaczek-Khinchin formula. This is the qualitative difference between the dual systems in question H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/M/1 and M/H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/1. A point for comparison of these systems is the average waiting time in the queue within the same system load. These data also vary. The conclusion for the average waiting time in the queue for both systems is based on the method of spectral decomposition in solution of the integral equation Lindley.

Author Keywords: average waiting time in the queue

articleTitle: Methodology for Identifying Critical Vulnerabilities in Distributed Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The urgency of using modern mathematical methods in analyzing the reliability and fault tolerance of distributed system elements is not in doubt at this time. The trend of using the theory of stationary processes as a basis for methodologies for analysis and decision making has become global. To ensure the reliability and fault tolerance of distributed systems, modern analyzes include a mathematical device that allows you to unambiguously and quantitatively assess the state of the system, find bottlenecks and determine the direction of modernization. Identification of the bottleneck in the distributed data storage system was carried out on the basis of the developed data conversion mechanism.

articleTitle: New Technologies and Precision Measuring Transformations Radiosignals and the Perspectives of Use of their use for Systems of Control with safe Literal Appliances (UAVs)
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The project is aimed at addressing an important application that acted acutely within the framework of the ATO, as well as providing protection against unauthorized attacks on information on the territory of Ukraine, through the use of unmanned intelligence systems. The indicated means use two defining principles - radio control, and the transmission of television information by radio channels. The existing fleet of unmanned flying and mobile vehicles uses both classical and modern radio data transmission equipment using noise immunity (FFSS, ADT, GSM, CDMA, etc.). Therefore, the classical well-known means of Radio-electronic struggle (REB), which are at the present level, are not capable of ensuring the fulfillment of two principles and tasks: - suppression (failure in the management of the trajectory of motion), and most importantly, blocking the transmission of teleinformation in real time, precisely for signal-code design of signals, use of orthogonal processing and secrecy of transmission on random channels of ”broadband noise-like” communication channels. It is proposed to develop and order the production of the newest REB based on the use of the original principles of the phase-frequency theory of measurement and transformation of radio signals.

articleTitle: Optimization of Ways to Achieve the Amplitude Balance in Optoelectronic Information Links
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The problem of noise control for information links is considered. The emitters and receivers parameters as well as coupling efficiency are reviewed. The ways of connection of single-mode and multimode fibers or emitters and photodetectors with fibers of various types is considered. The technical implementation of the advanced technological process to simplify the achievement of the amplitude balance in optoelectronic information links is proposed.

articleTitle: Proactive Approach for Security of the Infocommunication Network Based on Vulnerability Assessment
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper explores methods for assessing vulnerabilities and assessing the spread of an attack in an infocommunication network. A proactive approach to the quantitative assessment of network security, which allows us to assess risks at the user and network level through the presence of vulnerabilities is presented. The proposed solutions will be useful for decision making and will be further integrated into a single metric for displaying the integrated level of security of the infocommunication network.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effectiveness of Tariffs for Telecommunications Services with Broadband Access
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The purpose of the study was to analyze the efficiency of tariffs of companies providing telecommunications services with broadband access. The analysis was carried out with respect to both the efficiency of the tariff system in general and its individual elements. The structure of costs for services providing access to the Internet and networks of digital television has been studied. The scheme of the analysis of the product and cost parts of the tariff system of telecommunication companies is proposed. The advantages and disadvantages of pricing strategies for telecommunication services are discussed.

articleTitle: The Investigation of Depending the Dispersion from Changes of the Optical Fibers Refractive Index Profile
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: in this paper, we investigate the dependence of the optical fiber dispersion on such factors of the change in the refractive index profile: the profile height, the core radius, the intermediate shell depth, and its width. To this end, mathematical models of the refractive index profiles of optical fibers have been developed. Step-wise approximation was used for the mathematical description of the profiles. An algorithm for studying the effect of a welded connection of a dispersion-modified optical fiber on the degree of variance change is proposed. The obtained results showed that the dispersion can increase significantly with a significant deviation of the refractive index profile from the initial form, which can lead to distortions of the transmitted signal.

articleTitle: Analysis of Human Speech as a Protection Tool in Infocommunication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Task is established to construct the bionic model of human identification by speech parameters. Topic relevance is noted due to the need for improving the functional quality and reliability of infocommunicational systems, providing security for users and voice accessable objects.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection in Multiservice Network on the Basis of Registered Traffic Filtration
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper proposes a detection option of the anomalous component of the observed traffic based on traffic processing by a linear filter with a known impulse response. Based on a comparison of the current value of the mean-square filter error with the "reference" value obtained by filtering traffic without anomalies, it is possible to detect attacks that change the statistical properties of the traffic. When filtering traffic without anomalies, the mean square filter error is determined by the cross correlation function of the observed traffic without intrusions and traffic at the output of the linear filter. The impulse response of such traffic is determined by the correlation properties of the "reference" traffic. The presence of an intrusion into the observed traffic changes its correlation properties. This leads to a noticeable increase in the mean-square filter error. Comparison of the obtained value of the mean-square error with the "reference" value allows to draw conclusions about the presence of an anomalous component.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Improvement Method for Signal Processing in Optical Telecommunication
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper represents effectiveness improvement method for signal processing in optical telecommunication systems using dense wavelength division multiplexing (DWDM) technology. The realization principles and mathematical description are given for optical carrier modulator with external modulator. The circuit design is described for electro-optical modulators and optical radiation transmitting units while forming signals of digital multi-position keying. The algorithm and realization schemes are offered for digital processing multilevel phase-modulated signals of the optical radiation. The imitation scheme is offered to research principles of forming signals of phase manipulation, which considers dispersion effect to system productivity. The results are obtained for chromatic dispersion and residual polarization effects in receiver and processing optical multi-position signals in telecommunication systems. The energy gain is evaluated for multi-position phase keying.

articleTitle: Modern Tendencies of Data Protection in the Corporate Systems of Information Consolidation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This work is devoted to investigation of the modern tendencies of data protection in the corporate systems of information consolidation. In particular, the role of information consolidation in the corporate systems of information consolidation is defined. The threats concerning data storage in the corporate systems of information consolidation are allocated. The main requirements to data protection in the corporate systems of information consolidation are given. The ways of data protection in the corporate systems of information consolidation are showed.

articleTitle: Simulation and Development of Impulse Ultrawideband Signal Generators for Wireless Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A block diagram and electric circuit of impulse radio ultrawideband signal generator based on step recovery diode are presented. The simulation results of the impulse radio ultrawideband signal generator with step recovery diode indicates the possibility of receiving at its output an impulse radio ultrawideband signal with a time duration less than 1 nanosecond, 0.3 - 2.5 GHz frequency bandwidth and a pulse amplitude that does not exceed 0.3...0.45 voltages. A prototype of impulse radio ultrawideband signal generator printed-circuit board also was developed, manufactured and tested. Test results shown that this prototype can generate impulse radio ultrawideband signal which occupies 0.6 - 2.7 GHz frequency bandwidth. This paper may be useful for impulse radio ultrawideband wireless communication system developers and researchers.

articleTitle: Mathematical Models of Blocks for Compensation Multipath Distortion in Spatially Separated Passive Time-Frequency Synchronization Radio System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Multipath propagation of radio waves negatively affects to the performance of telecommunications and radio navigation systems. When performing time and frequency synchronization tasks of spatially separated standards, the multipath signal propagation aggravates the probability of a correct synchronization and introduces an error. The presence of a multipath signal reduces the signal-to-noise ratio in the received signal, which in turn causes an increase in the synchronization error. If the time delay of the additional beam (s) is less than the useful signal duration, the reception of the useful signal is further complicated by the presence of a partially correlated interference, the level and correlation degree of which increases with decreasing time delay of the interference signals. The article considers with the method of multi-path interference compensation in a multi-position (telecommunication or radio navigation system) or a time and frequency synchronization system for the case if at least one of the receiving positions has no noise signal or does not exceed the permissible level. The essence of the method is that the interference-free useful signal is transmitted to other points in order to pick out the interference component from the signal / noise mix. As a result, an interference-free signal is used for further processing. The mathematical models of multipath interference suppressors in the temporal and in the frequency domain are presented in the article. Compared to time processing, processing in the frequency domain reduces computational costs. The operation of the suppressor in the time domain has been verified experimentally.

articleTitle: Fibonacci Binary-Decimal Count in Infocommunication Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper, we consider a high-speed Fibonacci-decimal modular counter, which makes it possible to detect errors, both directly during the count, and during the transmission of the received information via communication channels. Along with this, it makes it possible to use the modular principle of building counters and equipment, where they are applied, which reduces the cost of production and operation. It can effectively be used in various radio electronic devices and, especially, in measuring technology.

articleTitle: Deterministic Chaos in Vibrations of Discrete Structures of Matrix Type
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: It shows the possibility of modeling regimes of deterministic chaos in vibrations of discrete structures, which formed as special matrix forms of the Latin square. A mathematical model of such discrete systems, which based of an analysis is made of the conditions for combining the discrete structure and the requirements for transformations of the operator of its evolution, which ensure the achievement of such modes, is proposed. Results of imitation modeling of oscillatory processes on cycles of discrete system states, which forming similarity of attractor trajectories, are represented.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Candidates for a Post-Quantum CPU Based on MQ Cryptographic Transformation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The purpose of the thesis is to consider the entities that were selected as candidates for the post-quantum standard, their comparative analysis, and also the development of proposals for the improvement and application of DES algorithms in a restricted class of only MQ cryptographic transformations. The research process used recognized or recommended criteria and indicators of evaluation, as well as appropriate methods. The analysis of NIST PQC contest candidates for the post-quantum digital electronic signature standard based on multivariate transformations is carried out. Based on a comparative analysis of electronic signature schemes, two prospective candidates for the post-quantum standard were selected.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fractal Coding UHD Images with Parametric Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The results of application of the modified genetic algorithm of fractal coding to still images and video sequences are presented. The dependence of the compression coefficient on the size of the rank block is obtained. Comparison of fractal compression with standard MPEG-4 compression algorithms is performed and it is shown that it is possible to achieve double the compression coefficients at the same signal-to-noise ratio values. In the video sequence, both I-frames and predicted P, B frames were subjected to fractal compression. The simulation results showed what time in seconds is spent when encoding one frame.

articleTitle: Criteria for Evaluation of Characteristics of Photon Switchboards Optical Signals and Optical Fibres for the Quantum Systems of Transfer Confidential Information
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Further development of optical communication is connected with creation of completely optical photon networks in which processes of switching, transfers, reception and processing of signals occurs at purely photon level. Photon switchboards with optical management, optical amplifiers with remote optical food, generators of optical impulses with the set parameters and a number of passive optical elements are developed for realization of this task. In article on the basis of theoretical and pilot studies the system of parameters for assessment of characteristics of photon switchboards of optical signals and optical fibers for the quantum systems of transfer of confidential information allowing to optimize process of development of the next generations of photon switchboards of optical communication networks is defined. The photon switchboard allowing to reduce quantity of mechanical elements and knots with an irregular geometrical shape and a configuration, to raise the accuracy of process of photon switching, to reduce lag effect due to lack of mechanical side plays between knots and to increase operational reliability is developed because optical fibers aren't exposed to deformation, i.e., are in a motionless state.

articleTitle: SQL-On-Hadoop Systems: Evaluting Performance of Polybase for Big Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Performance of the bridge PolyBase SQL Server for working with hybrid data stores has been investigated. The analysis of the existing bridges for joint processing of SQL-and NoSQL data with using of a Hadoop cluster has been carried out. Technologies for query optimization when using PolyBase have been represented. The paradigm of data splitting and applying the pushdown procedure has been considered. Results of using the procedure predicate pushdown for the suggested metrics of PolyBase-Hadoop system performance have been considered for examples of processing test data of large volumes.

articleTitle: Branched Bispectrum-Based Encoding Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Novel branched bispectrum-based redundant encoding technique is suggested for wireless communication systems operating in radio links contaminated by noise and strong frequency selective fading. Interference resistant code using bispectrum-arranged triplet-signals is proposed. Communication performance for suggested encoding technique is studied for multipath Rayleigh and Rician wireless channel models by computer simulations. It is demonstrated that bispectrum-based encoding technique provides considerable gain of interference immunity in noisy and fading communication channels as compared with common branched redundant communication systems.

articleTitle: Multicomponent Model of Objects Attributive Signatures on Color Pictures
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A technique for multicomponent model synthesis aimed at description of color, geometric and structural attributes of objects images on pictures is suggested. In terms of the model an object is represented as a hierarchical set of embedded contours, wherein the upper level of the object topological representation is the description of the external boundary of that object image and the lower levels of the topology detailing correspond to the internal structure elements. For the contours detection color information of the picture statistically homogeneous regions is used. To select the external contour points an algorithm for forming the contour circular sweep with the uniform angle step as well as the methods for binding contour points, which are based on the criterion of distance between the neighboring points of the contour have been developed. The presented results testify the possibility of using the suggested technique in the procedures of recognition of graphical objects.

articleTitle: Comparison of Average Characteristics of Various Queuing Systems using Spectral Method
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The solution of the Lindley integral equation using the characteristics of real traffic is presented, which allowed obtaining an analytical expression for the average waiting time of packets in the queue and the average number of packets in the system. The transmission delay of the packet is compared in a network by the spectral method for two queuing systems of the types M/M/1 and G/G/1. This solution shows that in the real network there are distributions with a "heavy" tail which allow not to drop new incoming packets when the queuing system G/G/1 buffer is full.

Author Keywords: the statistical characteristics of the network

articleTitle: Analysis of the Technologies and Methodologies of Data Transmission in Distributed Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper the main methods and technologies of data distribution and delivery are presented. A lot of algorithms which allow selecting the optimum route and server for the content requests of users were described. Also monitoring methods that always allow having the latest information about the status of any server and making optimum load distribution between all edge servers were depicted.

articleTitle: Efficiency Estimation of MPEG Encoder with Different Configurations of Inter-Frame Coding in Infocommunication Multimedia Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article is devoted to the in-depth analysis of efficiency for video compression algorithms during interframe coding and impairments that appearing during compression. The main purpose of studies is carrying out analysis in direction of defining requirements for instant and long-term bit-rate for video services with different criticality to video processing taking into account number of factors, particularly from different variants of inter-coding implementation. Results of such studies are related to complement information for other studies results and availability of such results useful during definition of video bit-rate requirements for streaming applications. Studies are based on usage of modern simulation technologies that is also applied for prototyping of hardware encoding devices. This provides possibility of analysis of efficiency of video encoders on different video processing stages. As result of simulation, performance of the video algorithm was analyzed; possible ways of increasing its efficiency were proposed and bit-rate requirements are formulated. The obtained results can be used for resource planning for introduction of video services and also during scientific studies in direction of video compression algorithms efficiency increasing.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Automatic Generation of Hotel Descriptions Using Templates Based on Markov Chains
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The work is devoted to solving the problem of information presence of hotels on the Internet. In a significant proportion of hotels, there is no text description for presentation in the profile of the hotel. But there are sets of structured data that characterize the hotel and they can form a text description. Hence the actuality of the problem follows, namely the development of the algorithm of automated text generation and on its basis the implementation of a program system for generating descriptions of hotels. The scientific novelty of the obtained results - is the first time developed the algorithm of automatic generation of the object description for the data set of its characteristics on the basis of templates using the method of the Markov chains.

articleTitle: Improvement of Methods Motion Compensation of Dynamic Objects Moving in Video Stream in the Videoconferencing System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Videoconferencing gives us the opportunity to work and communicate in real time, as well as to use collective applications, interactive information exchange. Videoconferencing systems are one of the basic components of the organization of manegment, ensuring, the timeliness and necessary quality management of the implementation of objective control over the solution of the tasks. The quality of the image and the time of transmission of video information is unsatisfactory for the quality control of the troops. Considered ways to increase the efficiency of management and operational activities, due to methods of compensation of motion, using technology to reduce the volume of video data for quality improvement.

articleTitle: Upper Layer Quality Control for Real-Time Video Services in Telecommunication Environments with Non-Guaranteed QoS
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article is devoted to the analysis of upper layer quality control for real-time video services based on MPEG Transport Stream during delivery via telecommunication networks with non-guaranteed Quality of Service (with packet loss, random error distribution, etc.). The main purpose of these studies is to propose possible normative values for indicators of quality of operation of real time video services in telecommunication environments that simplifying prediction and detection of service failures in operative way. Experimental part of work is based on simulation of service failures for real transport streams with different structures and performance with usage of measurement guidelines of related standard ETSI TR 101 290 [1]. As result of studies the estimations of quality indicators are obtained and corresponding recommendations/ propositions are formulated. The obtained results can be used during implementation and operational monitoring of real-time video services by service providers as basis for their own operational practices and during scientific studies for improvement performance of quality monitoring systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of User Groups in Social Networks to Detect Socially Dangerous People
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article proposes a method for identifying socially dangerous people on the basis of metadata left by a user during registration in groups of social networks. This method will allow law enforcement agencies to identify socially dangerous elements of the society that actively use social networks in an unattended mode. Additionally, the method functions without violating the constitutional rights of users to privacy, with respect to personal correspondence. To increase the accuracy while identifying socially dangerous people, it was proposed to use a neural network that allows solving problems with reinforcement learning techniques. The article focuses on structuring the analytical system of social groups, on the scheme of an adaptive neural network, on the stages of the dictionary compilation for an adaptive neural network. Further, the article describes a software package with the help of which the idea of identifying socially dangerous people was realized. The authors provide the code for processing the request for text classification in the server of the neural network. The program complex is written implementing two programming languages: JavaScript and Java. To confirm the program functioning, the screen shot of the program-testing interface is given. It illustrates the process of identifying socially dangerous people on the basis of three selected criteria: normal, aggressive and suicidal. The results were verified by a psychologist on the basis of a special projective methods of personality assessment.

articleTitle: Receive “In General” for OFDM Signas in Memory Channels with Doppler Shift
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The algorithm processing orthogonal frequency multiplexing (OFDM) signals in memory channels with Doppler shift is covered in the article. The offered algorithm is based on OFDM symbol sequence processing “in general” on dispersion interval with purpose of receiving maximum likelihood estimates of above sequence to get result of transferred QAM-symbols according to the classical scheme with usage of FFT. The statistical modeling of RGEWDM (reception in general with element-wise decision-making) algorithm processing OFDM-symbols was done using Jakes model of channel. This modeling was shown high characteristics of noise immunity in memory channels with Doppler shift.

Author Keywords: Communication channel with dispersion and Doppler shift
estimations of“reception in general' algorithm on dispersion interv al statistical modeling

articleTitle: Classification of Fractal Time Series Using Recurrence Plots
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article considers classification task of fractal time series by the random forest method. It is proposed to classify time series as features to use the quantitative characteristics of recurrent plots. Time series of fractal Brownian motion were selected as input time series. The comparative analysis of different time series classification was held. The difference between fractal Brownian motion and fractal Gaussian noise in probabilities determining class and significant features are quite large. For fractal Brownian motion, it is enough recurrence features, while for fractal Gaussian noise it is necessary to use the estimate of H (except persistent series). The average probabilities for fractal Brownian motion are higher than for fractal Gaussian noise. For fractal Brownian motion, the most important features are ones of laminarity and determinism. For fractal Gaussian noise the laminar measure is not important, but the measures of average recurrence time and white vertical lines are significant. The results show that the important for the classification of fractal series is what kind of series is persistent or antipersistent. The results indicate the advantage of the recurrent features over the statistical and fractal ones.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Method for Solving the Traveling Salesman Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An evolutionary method for solving the traveling salesman problem in the field of pharmacy business by optimizing the work of the drug delivery device is proposed in this paper. Modifications of three methods of initialization of the initial population of the genetic algorithm are developed. The software based on the proposed evolutionary method is created. It allows changing the initial parameters of the genetic algorithm, observe the process of solving the salesman problem graphically, obtain a result in text and graphic forms.

articleTitle: Development Algorithmic Model for optimization of Distributed Fault-Tolerant Web-Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Algebraic optimization methods for balancing work, as well as a grid model, organization of load distribution, which is the basis of a hybrid transfer mechanism are considered in this paper. The theoretical foundations, which will ensure the effective functioning of the failure hierarchy and allow to effectively calculate the load of module nodes and nodes in general are considered. The principle of operation and functionality of the grid model, which is significantly different from the usual serial and parallel models was also considered. The main difference is the ability to aggregate and share large sets of heterogeneous resources distributed among geographically separated regions. In many cases, this brings great benefits, for example, when the system requires resources that are not available within the same node, it can receive resources from other nodes connected to the grid. The grid requires a change in the concept of an application error a Web-based network service generates an error message as soon as it is impossible to execute successfully.

Author Keywords: model, kernel space, network interface, time dependent metrics, parametric grid model

articleTitle: New Code Based Fuzzy Extractor for Biometric Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper methods of forming cryptographic keys from biometric images using fuzzy extractors are considered. A new scheme of a fuzzy extractor based on the McEIiece cryptosystem is proposed. It is shown that the new design of the fuzzy extractor allows forming cryptographic passwords from biometric images even without the use of non-secret helper string. When using helper string, the proportion of corrected distortions of biometric images increases significantly. In addition, the proposed design relates to a class of post-quantum information security methods, i.e. it is expected to be safely used even for solving cryptanalysis problems with universal quantum computers.

articleTitle: FinTech, Transformation of Financial Intermediation and Financial Stability
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The main directions, challenges, threats of development of the newest financial technologies-FinTech are considered. The trends and technological basis of digitalization of financial intermediation in the areas of payment systems, lending and deposits, insurance, investment management, financial trading are characterized. The possible effects of FinTech influence on the activities of traditional financial intermediaries are identified. The factors of FinTech distribution in Ukraine are revealed. Post-crisis world-view changes in the formulation of targets for the use of financial innovations and FinTech are substantiated. The spectrum of potential financial stability risks posed by FinTech, which requires systematic monitoring by entities providing financial stability, is determined. The necessity of providing a reliable level of information security of financial intermediation, taking into account a digitalization on the basis of new information and communication technologies and infocommunication systems, is substantiated.

articleTitle: Periodic Properties of Cryptographically Strong Pseudorandom Sequences
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: "Provable" strength generators of pseudo-random sequences have been considered in this paper, whose cryptanalysis problem reduces to solving a well-known and extremely complex mathematical problem related to the NP-complex class. In particular, the generators Blum-Blum-Shub, Rivest-Shamir-Adleman, Dual Elliptic Curve Deterministic Random Bit Generator and Pseudo-Random Generator Provably as Secure as Syndrome Decoding are considered. The periodic properties of generated pseudorandom sequences are investigated. It is shown that the considered generators do not allow forming sequences of the maximum period. In addition, for each generator there are initial states (weak keys), leading to catastrophically small lengths of the periods of generated sequences.

articleTitle: Modeling of the Data Center Resource Management Using Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Cloud data centers are most dynamic systems in a modern digital world. To deliver the high-performance and fault-tolerant IT services to end users effectively it is necessary to develop new methods for data center resource management while adapting to the emergence of new requirements. In this paper, the authors refine and evaluate the previously proposed method for cloud data center resource management based on the reinforcement learning approach. The proposed method takes into account the power consumption and the number of SLA violations in the management policy. The power consumption is managed by switching physical servers to active or sleep state depending on current utilization of three resources: CPU, memory, and network bandwidth. The proposed reinforcement learning agent allows to determine the optimal policy for managing the physical servers without creating an environment model and preliminary information about the workload. The evaluation results show that the proposed method allows to decrease the SLA violation time, to serve more VM schedule requests when the number of VMs is changing frequently, and to decrease the utilization of data center network due to decreased number of migrations.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Smart Rules Engine
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In embedded IoT applications, it's helpful to have rules engine patterns to support real-time processing of data from many sensors. This paper describes a Smart Rules Engine pattern model, in which the facts represent the description of the input data in a complex manner in the form of a dynamic situation at different levels of generalization and abstraction. A generalized description of the situation in the form of a set of facts is created automatically in real time using rules. Additionally, it describes a fact characteristic-a fuzzy confidence factor-which allows to take into account the uncertainty, incompleteness and relevance associated with the aging of the input data.

articleTitle: Comparison of Modern Network Attacks on TLS Protocol
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The Transport Layer Security (TLS) is cryptographic protocol that provides confidentiality and integrity of data in untrusted networks connections. The protocol is composed of two layers: the TLS Record Protocol for encapsulation of various higher-level protocols and the TLS Handshake Protocol for connection security. Nowadays TLS has become the secure standard of choice for Internet and mobile applications. There are many attacks on the TLS protocol that exploit its vulnerabilities: Cipher Block Chaining (CBC) mode encryption, data compression, using obsolete cypher suites and hash functions. Therefore, it is necessary to identify and examine existing threats of TLS. The paper explores the TLS protocol versions and main differences between them. In addition we consider the brand-new TLS version - TLS 1.3. Well-known network attacks (BEAST, CRIME, BREACH and DROWN), several additional attacks (SLOTH, ROBOT, Lucky 13) and their features are also considered. Finally, we compare reviewed attacks using own criteria that will help to understand the security of the TLS protocol at that moment.

articleTitle: Heuristic Methods of Hill Climbing of Cryptographic Boolean Functions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this article, heuristic methods of hill climbing for cryptographic Boolean functions satisfying the required properties of balance, nonlinearity, autocorrelation, and other stability indicators are considered. A technique for estimating the computational efficiency of gradient search methods is proposed, based on the construction of selective (empirical) distribution functions characterizing the probability of the formation of Boolean functions with indices of stability not lower than required. As an indicator of computational efficiency, an average number of attempts is proposed to be performed using a heuristic method to form a cryptographic Boolean function with the required properties. Comparative assessments of the effectiveness of the heuristic methods are considered.

articleTitle: Communication Messaging Models in IoT/WoT: Survey and Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper provides an overview and analysis of technologies, architectures, communication templates for smart objects, communication messaging models, and protocols of Internet of things/Web of things (IoT/WoT) for critical and non-critical systems. From the analysis it follows that the at present, there is no single approach to the choice of the messaging model and application-layer protocols for building the IoT/WoT, depending on the selected type of communication templates for smart objects. Therefore, the main goal of this paper is to create a technique for selecting messaging models and application-level protocols in noncritical and critical multi-level IoT/WoT systems, provided that the type of access to intelligent objects is initially specified by the initial data. To achieve this goal, in the paper were compared the main interrelated characteristics of IoT/WoT, the results of which are presented in the form of a table. The paper presents for the first time the technique created by authors which will be useful to developers of applications for a choice application-level protocols in the process of creating various multi-level IoT/WoT systems. The technique was tested by the authors on the example of a corporate system (Smart Home), based on the WoT concept.

articleTitle: Actual Problems of Information Technologies Use in the Telemedicine Services Provision in Special Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The possibilities and main methods of increasing the efficiency of using modern information technologies and telemedicine equipment after emergency situations are analyzed on the basis of analysis of the specifics of the provision of medical services in special conditions. It is proposed to consider the best practice of providing all medical services in special conditions and to identify areas for improving the use of modern information technologies in Ukraine in this field. Based on this analysis, the basic requirements for telecommunications and telemedicine for use in special conditions were developed, and methods were developed to improve the quality of telemedicine systems.

articleTitle: Authentication Process Threats in the Cloud Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The most challenging question in cybersecurity is protection the authentication process. Since a lot of companies decide to store their data in the cloud services, it is crucial to secure the authentication process here. First, I need to research all current threats to this process. Second, when I have all information for analyzing all vulnerabilities and find the best way to protect weak sides. Such research is needed because we need to know which exactly threats can lead to horrible consequences as identity thefts, data misuse, a compromise and so on. In this article, it is represented the main threats to the authentication process in the cloud services. The results show the focuses of the leading companies in the cybersecurity area. It makes easier to predict future threats and try to avoid them.

articleTitle: On Prediction of Image Denoising Expedience Using Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Assessment of image visual quality is important for different stages of image processing chain. One of them is denoising that can either improve image quality or remain it the same (or even degrade). Our paper concerns the question on whether or not the use of denoising is expedient for a given image. A common model of additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) is used. Analysis of denoising expedience is based on prediction of visual quality for acquired noisy image. A peculiarity of the proposed approach is that it employs a trained neural networks (NN) and does not require a priori known noise variance. The NN uses features extracted from spectral domain as inputs and carries out prediction of visual quality metrics for noisy image. The prediction is much faster than denoising itself and appropriately accurate. Besides, this paper evaluates the existing full-reference image quality metrics with application to image denoising using Spearman rank-order correlation coefficient (SROCC). The best SROCC values do not exceed 0.81. The image database and codes are available online at https://github.com/ViA-RiVaL/Image-Denoising-Expedience/.

articleTitle: Practical Application of the Graphic Processing Unit for Data Encryption on the UAV On-Board Computer
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) in our time are being used increasingly in various critical areas of human activity to collect large amounts of data. Unauthorized access to this information can lead to serious consequences. Various means and methods of cryptographic data protection are used to prevent unauthorized access to data. In this article we propose the practical solution for providing on-line encryption of application data received by the UAV. The capabilities of the graphic processing unit (GPU) of the on-board computer are used for these purposes. The proposed solution, in addition to reliable protection of the received application data, reduces the load on the central processor of the on-board computer and makes the most efficient use of the capabilities of the UAV hardware platform.

articleTitle: Method of Data Openness Estimation Based on User-Experience in Infocommunication Systems of Municipal Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article considers the method of determining the integral estimation of information openness presented on the sites of communal enterprises. The proposed methodology is supposed to be used by local authorities to monitor the implementation of the provisions of the Laws of Ukraine ”On Access to Public Information”, ”On Information” and a number of sectoral regulatory acts regulating the activities of communal enterprises.

articleTitle: Overview and Analysis of Existing Decisions of Determining the Meaning of Text Documents
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper reviews and analyzes existing solutions for determining the meaning of text documents. Typical questions and problems of determining the meaning of text documents used in modern systems are discussed.
