The most used models and methods of semantic text processing are considered, as well as the classical process of text processing in semantic analysis. In the course of the analysis, it was found that when using the models considered, in practice, a partial loss of meaningful meaning of the text occurs, which in turn is not always justified, although it allows performing certain procedures of semantic analysis, although it misses the features. The most frequently used libraries of semantic analysis are analyzed in different programming languages such as Java, Rybi, C #, PHP. It should be noted that the considered libraries of semantic analysis operate in the same way, the results of their work are quite similar. Therefore, when developing, it is necessary to take into account specific goals and tasks that the developer must solve, as well as in what functional-style types of texts are analyzed. It is also expedient to perform a statistical analysis of the work of these libraries, on the same tasks and texts. It was found that it is advisable to develop a single system for solving the problem of analyzing and evaluating texts according to different criteria, for example, analyzing texts for text borrowings and borrowing ideas, as well as for determining the authorship of the text, taking into account its paraphrasing.

Author Keywords: definition of the meaning of the text

articleTitle: Estimation of Structural-Topological Characteristics in Information Security System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: probability; cryptography; security of data; Internet; queueing theory; decision making; autonomous aerial vehicles; optimisation; learning (artificial intelligence); image coding.

articleTitle: The Concept of Device Meta-Model for Real-Time Communication in the Transboundary Environment Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the issues of environmental monitoring of transboundary territories. The authors considered the case of any technological accident that took place on the territory that is not under the control of particular state authorities (for example, in the neighbouring country). In such circumstances, the chargeable rescue services have to react on the outcomes of the emergency in the conditions of lack, incompleteness and inaccuracy of information collected from the transboundary territories. To gather the environmental data different state services use various measurement devices and tools. This data has to be transferred in a fastest manner to the single crisis center that is usually expanded to coordinate different rescue services and organize a decision-making process in case of emergency. In order to make the management decisions more efficient the authors suggest a new approach of fast emergency infrastructure deployment. The described approach is based on service-oriented architecture of the information system that supports a real-time communication of devices that collect environmental information. The suggested device meta-model identifies common elements across all devices involved in emergency recovery and allows to connect any new devices to the existing infrastructure. Thus, the collected information can be transferred quickly and uninterruptedly to the decision support system in order to coordinate activities and provide communication between geographically separated locations.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling and Analysis of Destabilization Threats in Computer Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: One of the key issues in ensuring the safe functioning of network computer systems is testing, which needs a formal description of such systems by an appropriate mathematical model. That's why it is necessary to carry out a statistical study of network ensembles, modeling their topology and development processes. The integral probability characteristics of real computer networks are calculated in different intervals of time, their approximation is carried out for modeling. The original mathematical model for generating the structure of computer network systems with a given function of density of degree distribution of nodes and a generalized model of the network ensemble evolution under the conditions of destabilization threats were developed. The restored network received as a result of simulation in the form of a stochastic graph has parameters that are close to the real network, which enables studying the nature of the formation and development of networks, simulation of infection and immunization tasks. The problem of network resilience to accidental and targeted attacks was solved.

articleTitle: Telecommunication System Construction Principles for Radio Communication in the Terahertz Frequency Range on the Harmonic Technology Signal as a Information Carrier Basis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: On the basis of theoretical calculations confirmed by modeling, the principles of construction of the ultra-wideband radio communication system in the terahertz frequency range on the basis of electronics technology using the harmonic signal as a carrier of information have been substantiated. The analysis of the current state of the problem was made and the task of creating a terahertz telecommunication system of broadband radio access with a gigabit bandwidth in the range of operating frequencies 130-134 GHz was performed. Terahertz frequency range areas that are most suitable for use in radio relay communication lines are selected Physical simulation of ultrahigh-speed shaper based on multi-frequency multistelection of modulated OFDM digital streams has been carried out, bench testing and optimization have been performed to achieve the maximum bandwidth of the channel for transmission of digital stream information in the format of Ethernet to the full channel speed at full duplex up to 1.2 Gbit/with. On the basis of the generalization of the results of theoretical research and experimental work, the analysis of the existing radio relay element base, the design of the main nodes of the receiving and transmitting path of a telecommunication system with a gigabit throughput in the frequency range 130-134 GHz. The scientific novelty of the work consists in generalization and development of the theory of distribution, formation and measurement of terahertz signals, in the development of multifrequency multiplexing method and the formation of modulated OFDM digital streams in the terahertz frequency range and the development of the principles of functional design on the basis of electronics technology using the harmonic signal as a carrier of information in the transceiver tract of telecommunication system with gigabit bandwidth in terahertz frequent range.

Author Keywords: frequency range of radio waves’s distribution

articleTitle: Methods for Improving the Quality of the Functional State Control of Aviation Enterprises Employees
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The quality of aviation security of airports by aviation security services, as well as the quality of air traffic control from air traffic controllers, depend to a large extent on their functional state. To reduce the influence of the human factor on safety, methods for monitoring the functional state of the employees of these services have been developed, aimed at creating systems that provide information support to persons who make managerial decisions about the degree of ability and willingness of an employee to perform production duties. To ensure control of the functional state of a person in the process of recruitment, periodic and pre-control monitoring, a graph hierarchical distributed model and a method of expert evaluation of a functional state, constructed on its basis with the use of fuzzy sets and perceptual calculations, were developed. To increase the validity of the assessment of the ability and readiness of a person to perform professional duties, it is proposed to introduce a new indicator - a psycho-physiological resource, which is determined on the basis of assessing the state of the cardiovascular system of a person. The developed models and methods for improving the quality of control of the functional state of aviation personnel are brought to practical implementation in information and analytical decision support systems. The article describes the architecture of the developed information system designed to manage the functional state of employees of aviation enterprises and the results of applying the developed model and method for ranking the job seekers for the position of an air traffic controller in terms of the indicators of the quality of a person's functional state.

articleTitle: Branch Information Technologies of Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article is devoted to the author's analysis of the evolution of Branch Information Technologies of Quality Management and the convergence of information technologies in the quality management process at all stages of the product life cycle. The “process approach” of this convergence allows to achieving the Quality Management System and Enterprise Management System goals. Modern strategies such as Business Performance Management and operational methods of Process Analytical Technology for achieving management objectives use application information technologies of Enterprise Resource Planning. Therefore, in the paper the Enterprise Resource Planning is presented as a platform for the convergence of standardized/proprietary formalized numerical methods for solution the challenges of Quality Management System and Enterprise Management System by the information technologies. Information technologies use processes and methods of searching, collecting, storing, processing, providing and disseminating large data collection and statistical tools for implementing these processes and methods. High performance Branch Information Technologies of Quality Management can be achieved and its failures can be prevented if will implemented the information technologies for systematically planned, monitored and managed in accordance with world standards. Iterative decision processes are organized in closed-loop Deming Cycle, the effectiveness of which is evaluated by risk-based methods, and adequate solutions are vested in the standards. Shown, that the Branch Information Systems of Quality Management is based on a method for improving business processes through the quality function deployment in order to represent the customer-oriented access by developing information modules of ERP-specific platform.

Author Keywords: Branch Information Technologies of Quality Management (BITQM)

articleTitle: Improving the Structure of Intellectual WattRouter for Optimize Self-Consumption of Energy Produced by Solar Panel
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A vital task of the research is the development of methods and information technologies for energy-efficient regulation of produced energy by household alternative energy sources. In particular, the problems of optimization of the structure of the intelligent ballast load control system and the creation of its energy-efficient operating modes. The aim of the work is to develop the structure of an intelligent system such as the WattRouter. The main task is to manage the ballast load based on the analysis of the indicators of consumed and generated energy and environmental parameters (temperature, humidity, pressure, weather forecast). An improved structure of the intellectual WattRouter was proposed on the basis of the use of the adaptive neuro-fuzzy logic unit for generating the conclusion and control information.

articleTitle: National Time Scale Transmitting Through the Integrated Power Networks of SMART Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article presents a comparative analysis of peculiarities of existing and advanced technologies, which provide timestamps for the process of continuous monitoring of the stability of power system parameters in accordance with the Smart Grid concept. A new synchronization mechanism, according to the IEEE-1588 standard, is considered, which can ensure a transmission of precise timestamps by packet switching technology, as well as the one that does not require a construction of a dedicated network. Experimental data of the research results of the Ukrainian equipment used for transmitting time scale of the “energy” profile by IP-network using the PTP protocol according to the IEEE-1588 standard.

articleTitle: Construction of Information-Effective Sensory and Local-Regional Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications. Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The technology of creation of information- and energy-efficient object and board systems of sensory networks based on the implementation by microcontrollers in the places of the network streams formation the algorithms for processing, encoding and transmitting the data optimized for speed and coding accuracy is proposed. Given the many limitations including limitations on the maximum speed of information transmission, the performance of object and onboard processors, the presence of incoming noise in the measuring links of sensors and interferences in the radio channel, the implementation of a algorithm complex of compact and secure encoding of monitoring signals and frames of video data is proposed. As a result of adaptation of algorithms of monitoring data encoding and transmission to incoming noise and channel interferences by subscribers of information-efficient sensor networks the protected packets of reliable information with increased information capacity are sent to the radio channel. The basis of high-quality encoding by subscriber processors of signals and images are the precise coding and recovery of the amplitude-time parameters of the most informative bypass samples including extremes and inflection points.

Author Keywords: encoding and transmission of signals and images
